Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa agenda kutandika omutwe ogukwata ku **emikyuka egya bulijjo** (daily changes) gye gikosaamu ebiramu n'obutonde bw'ensi.

Leka nnekennenya buli kibuuzo:

A. "Lwaki enjuba egwa olweggulo?" - Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka ya bulijjo (emisana n'ekiro)

B. "Lwaki emisana mimpi mu biseera by'obutiti?" - Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka za bulijjo ez'obudde/emisana

C. "Lwaki abantu bagoberera enkola ennamu mu biseera by'emisana?" - Kino kikwata ku nkola z'abantu, si nkyukakyuka za butonde

D. "Lwaki olowooza abantu abasinga balala kiro?" - Kino kikwata ku nkola z'abantu, si nkyukakyuka za butonde

Ekibuuzo ekisobozesa omusomesa **okwanjula ebyokuyiga** (to extend/deepen learning) eri abayizi kirina okuba ekibuuzo ekivaamu okulowooza okw'amaanyi era ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okutegeera obulungi emikyuka egya bulijjo.

Ekibuuzo **B** "Lwaki emisana mimpi mu biseera by'obutiti?" kivaamu okulowooza okw'amaanyi era kikwata ku nkyukakyuka za butonde ezya bulijjo (obudde/emisana).

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye: "Okunnyonnyola ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo."

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga abayizi okutegeera nti emiti gy'ebibala gikyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo (ebbugumu, enkuba, omusana, obutiti).

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okuzimba omuti - kino tekikebera butereevu okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka.

B. Okwawula emiti egibala n'egitabala - kino tekikwatagana n'ekigendererwa eky'enkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka.

C. Okukolela langi emiti okusinziira ku biseera by'omwaka - Kino kikwatagana butereevu n'ekigendererwa! Abayizi balaga okutegeera nti buli muti gulina enkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo nga bakwataganya omuti n'ekiseera kyagwo.

D. Okukwataganya omuti n'ekibala - kino kikebera okumanya ebibala byokka, si enkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku **endowooza enkyamu** ku mutima.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

A. "Omutima gweyongera okuba omugumu okuyita mu mizannyo" - Kino si kituufu. Omutima si mubiri ogweyongera okuba omugumu. Omutima gw'omubiri ogukola omusaayi, si mubiri ogufaanana ng'emyunyeto egweyongera okuba emigumu.

B. "Omutima gw'omuntu gulinga ekikonde kye" - Kino si kituufu. Omutima si kikonde, era obunene bwagwo tebukwatagana na kikonde kya muntu.

C. "Omutima gusobozesa omusaayi okutambuza omukka ogwa oxygen okugenda mu mubiri" - Kino kituufu! Omutima gukola omusaayi, era omusaayi gwe gutambuza omukka ogwa oxygen.

D. "Omutima gukola omusaayi ogugenda mu buli kitundu ky'omubiri" - Kino nakyo kituufu! Omulimu gw'omutima gwe gukola omusaayi.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza **endowooza enkyamu**, kale nneetegeera nti:

- C ne D bituufu
- A ne B si bituufu

Mu A ne B, **A** y'endowooza enkyamu esinga okubaawo mu baana - okulowooza nti omutima gweyongera okuba omugumu nga emyunyeto.

**A**

# Nnekennenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kintu ki omusomesa ky'akubiriza abaana okukozesa mu kibuuzo ky'ababuuzizza?

Ekibuuzo omusomesa ky'abuuza kye kino: **"Kiki ekinaabaawo singa tubiteeka mu mazzi?"**

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

**A. Okukebereza** - Kino kitegeeza okulaba n'okwegera ebintu nga bwe biri

**B. Okwekenneenya okukulemberwa** - Kino kitegeeza okwekenneenya okutwalira awamu

**C. Okuteebereza ebinaavaamu** - Kino kitegeeza okulowooza ku ebinaatuuka nga tonnaba bikola (prediction/hypothesis)

**D. Okugeraageranya ku bubaka** - Kino kitegeeza okufaanaganya ebintu

Ekibuuzo "Kiki ekinaabaawo singa tubiteeka mu mazzi?" kyebuuza abaana okulowooza ku ebinaatuuka **nga tonnaba biteeka mu mazzi**. Kino kye **kuteebereza** oba **okukola hypothesis**.

**C**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo

Omusomesa alaga ekiigezo mw'ayiwa ebintu ebisatu mu butto: amazzi, butto w'emmere, ne giriserini.

Bw'ankenenya obutto:
- Butto w'emmere ne giriserini byambukira waggulu
- Amazzi gasigala wansi

Kino kiraga nti ebintu birina obuzito obutali bwe bimu. Ebintu ebisingawo obuzito (amazzi) bisigala wansi, ate ebyo ebirina obuzito obutono (butto w'emmere ne giriserini) byambukira waggulu.

Kino kye kintu ekikola ebintu ekiyitibwa **obungi bw'ekintu** (density) - engeri ekintu gye kizitowa oba obuzito bwakyo okusinziira ku bunene bwakyo.

**A**
D

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo:

Kibuuzo kino kyogera ku **nkyukakyuka y'embeera y'ekintu okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi**.

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A. Enfuufu** - Kino si nkyukakyuka y'embeera, wabula kya kintu/ekintu.

**B. Okufuuyuka** - Kino kwe kukyuka okuva mu **mazzi (liquid) okudda mu ggaasi (gas)** - si kituufu.

**C. Okutulukuka** - Kino kwe kukyuka okuva mu **ngumu (solid) okudda mu ggaasi (gas)** nga teyitamu mu mbeera y'amazzi - **Kino kituufu!**

**D. Okutabika** - Kino kwe kukyuka okuva mu **ggaasi okudda mu ngumu** - si kituufu.

**C**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okutegeera ebintu ebikola obudde (weather elements/factors).

Ebintu ebikola obudde ebikulu bye bino:
- **Obudde** (weather/climate conditions)
- **Ebbugumu** (temperature)
- **Empewo** (wind)
- **Enkuba** (rain/precipitation)
- **Ebiseera by'omwaka** (seasons)

Nneekebera buli kyokulabirako:

**A. Obudde, enkuba, n'ebiseera by'omwaka**
- Kino kirimu ebintu ebikulu naye "obudde" kiyinza okuba nga kigambo ekigazi ennyo

**B. Empewo, ebiseera by'omwaka, n'ebbugumu**
- Kino kirimu ebintu ebikulu ebikola obudde: empewo (wind), ebiseera by'omwaka (seasons), n'ebbugumu (temperature)
- Bino byonna bintu ebinyonnyoleka ebikola obudde

**C. Okutonnyesa, omuyaga, n'obudde**
- "Okutonnyesa" si kintu kikulu nnyo mu kunnyonnyola obudde

**D. Obudde, empewo, n'enkuba**
- Kino kirimu ebintu ebikulu

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga ebintu ebinyonnyoleka ebikola obudde. **Ekyokulabirako B** kirimu ebintu ebisatu ebinyonnyoleka ebikulu: empewo, ebiseera by'omwaka, n'ebbugumu.

**B**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku nsonga enkulu evaako empewo okukunta mu nnyanja.

## Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Omuyaga** - Omuyaga gwe mulimu gw'empewo ezikunta, naye si nsonga enkulu eyazireeta. Omuyaga ye nkola, si nsonga.

**B. Amaanyi agasikira ebintu ku Mwezi** - Amaanyi ga Mwezi (gravitational pull) ge galeeta empewo okukunta. Mwezi bw'asikira amazzi g'ennyanja, galeeta tides (empewo ezikunta n'okuwanduka).

**C. Enjawulo mu bwoki bw'omu bbanga** - Kino kikwata ku mbeera y'obudde, si nsonga enkulu ey'empewo okukunta.

**D. Enkyukakyuka mu bwoki bw'amazzi g'ennyanja** - Kino kiva ku mpewo okukunta, si nsonga eyazireeta.

Ensonga enkulu ey'empewo okukunta ye **amaanyi ga Mwezi agasikira amazzi** (tidal forces).

**B**

# Nkola y'Okunoonyereza

Leka nnekennekenye ekibuuzo:

**Ekibuuzo kikwata ku:**
- Omusomesa alaga vidiyo eraga ekintu ekivaamu obwewunzike bw'enkondo y'ensi
- Obwewunzike buno buleeta ekitundu ky'obukiikakkono n'eky'obukiikaddyo **okumulisa obutali bumu okw'omusana**
- Kino kijja okuva mu **nsi gy'etambulira okwetoloola omusana**

**Ebintu ebikulu:**
1. Enkondo y'ensi (axis tilt)
2. Obutali bumu okw'omusana mu bitundu eby'enjawulo
3. Ensi etambulira okwetoloola omusana

**Nnekennekenye obuyinza:**

A. Emigga gy'amazzi mu nnyanja - Kino tekikwatagana n'enkondo y'ensi n'okwetoloola omusana

B. Ebiseera by'omwaka - **Kino kituufu!** Obwewunzike bw'enkondo y'ensi nga ensi etambulira okwetoloola omusana kye kireeta ebiseera by'omwaka (seasons) - ekitundu ky'obukiikakkono ne ky'obukiikaddyo bifuna omusana obutali bumu mu biseera eby'enjawulo

C. Emisana n'ekiro - Kino kijja okuva mu nsi okwetooloola (rotation), si okwetoloola omusana (revolution)

D. Emigga gy'amazzi - Tekikwatagana n'enkondo y'ensi n'okwetoloola omusana

**B**

Nsomooza embeera eno:

Ignacio annyonnyola nti:
- Clownfish efuna obukuumi okuva ku ttooki y'ennyanja (ekiganyulo)
- Ttooki y'ennyanja ekuumibwa kubanga clownfish egoba ebyennyanja ebirala ebigirya (ekiganyulo)

Kino kye kitegeeza nti **ebyennyanja byombi bifuna emiganyulo** okuva mu nkolagana yaabyo.

Nnekaliriza ebyokuddamu:

A. Obuwangwa - ekimu kiganyulwa, ekirala tekirina kye kifuna ❌

B. Amensalism - ekimu kiremesebwa, ekirala tekirina kye kifiirwa ❌

C. Obutalina ludda - si kituufu ❌

D. Omukwano ogw'obuyambi obwa buli omu - **byombi biganyulwa** ✓

**D**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga abayizi okutegeera **amakulu g'obwolekero bw'obusaale mu nsaano z'emmere**.

Nsaano z'emmere (food chains) ziraga engeri emmere/amasoboza bwe gyita okuva ku kiramu ekimu okudda ku kirundi:
- Ebimera (producers) → Abalya ebimera (herbivores) → Abalya ensolo (carnivores)

**Obwolekero bw'obusaale** (direction of arrows) mu nsaano z'emmere bulaga:
- Engeri amasoboza bwe gakulukuta
- Emmere evaayo wa okudda wa

Leka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Empyaamida z'omuwendo gw'abantu** - Kino kikwata ku bungi bw'ebiramu mu buli mutendera, naye si kye kikulu okutegeera obwolekero bw'obusaale.

**B. Emikwano gy'ebiramu egy'enjawulo** - Kino kigazi nnyo. Obwolekero bw'obusaale bulaga emikwano gya "okulya n'okuliibwa" - ani alya ani.

**C. Abaguzi abakulu n'abaguzi abaddala** - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'okumalawo, si ku nsaano z'emmere.

**D. Enkyukakyuka n'okukuuma amasoboza** - Kino kikulu naye si kye kikulu okutegeera obwolekero bw'obusaale.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi batuuke ku kutegeera nti sayansi ekola nga ekibiina era nga ekyuka (evolves). Kino kitegeeza:
- Sayansi si mulimu gw'omuntu omu yekka
- Sayansi ekulaakulana okuyita mu kiseera
- Bannasayansi bakola ku mulimu gw'abalala

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okukola omutindo mu bibinja - kino kiraga okukola nga ekibiina naye tekikwata ku nkulaakulana/enkyukakyuka mu kiseera

B. Okunoonyereza ku nkulaakulana - kino kiraga ZOMBI: enkyukakyuka (evolution) mu kiseera n'okukola nga ekibiina (research involves building on others' work)

C. Akapanero - kino kiyinza okulaga amawulire naye tekikakasa nnyo ku nkulaakulana n'okukola nga ekibiina

D. Olutalo lw'ebiseera - kino kiraga bulungi enkyukakyuka mu kiseera n'abannasayansi abaayambako (ekibiina), era lulaga engeri sayansi gy'ekulaakulanamu

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku "nkulaakulana ez'omulembe" - kino kitegeeza enkyukakyuka mu kiseera. Olutalo lw'ebiseera (timeline) lwe lukola obulungi ennyo okulaga enkyukakyuka n'abannasayansi abaayambako.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **enkola y'okuzimba** (adaptive immunity) nga ekitundu ku bujjaasi obw'omuzaaliranwa.

Enkola y'okuzimba erimu:
- T lymphocytes (T cells)
- B lymphocytes (B cells) 
- Okukola antibodies ezisobola okujjukira obulwadde

Nnekalakasa buli kirowoozo:

**A**: Egamba nti macrophages tezitaffaali T lymphocytes antigens - Kino si kituufu nnyo era tekikwatagana bulungi n'enkola y'okuzimba.

**B**: Neutrophils ze ziri mu bujjaasi obw'omuzaaliranwa obw'amangu (innate immunity), si mu nkola y'okuzimba.

**C**: Egamba nti T cells ez'enjawulo ezikwatagana n'ekizimbamubiri ekimu zikola obuwumbiingirizi - Kino kye kituufu! Bino bye T cells (helper T cells, cytotoxic T cells) ezikola mu nkola y'okuzimba nga zikwatagana n'antigens ezisobola okujjukira.

**D**: Egamba nti B cells zifuuka plasma cells ezikola antibodies - Kino nakyo kituufu naye C esinga okwogera ku nkola y'okuzimba okutwalira awamu.

Ekyokulabirako C kisinga okulaga obulungi enkola y'okuzimba.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Okuleetera abayizi okumaliriza ku **mukago oguli wakati w'omulimu gw'enkola y'okumulisa emmere n'obwetaavu bw'amaselo ag'omu mubiri obw'ebyokulya**.

Kino kitegeeza nti abayizi balina okutegeera engeri enkola z'okumulisa emmere (enzymes) gye zikola okumenyaamenya emmere okugifuula mu bintu ebitonotono amaselo ge geetaaga.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Teebereza ekiteeso okumanya enkolagana wakati wa lipeesi ne lipidi.**
- Kino kikwata ku lipase (enzyme) ne lipids (amasanvu). Kino kisobola okulaga omulimu gw'enzymes naye si kya bulijjo nnyo.

**B. Okukola ekiigezo ku kikolwa kya amylase ava mu matta ku carbohydrates.**
- Kino kisobola okulaga enkola y'enzyme naye si kya bulijjo nnyo era tekikwatagana nnyo n'amaselo ag'omu mubiri.

**C. Ssaayansi mu kugezesa ku kikolwa kya pepsin ku puloteni.**
- Pepsin ye enzyme eri mu lubuto (stomach) emenyaamenya puloteni. Kino **kiragisa ddala** omulimu gw'enzyme (pepsin) mu kumenyaamenya emmere (puloteni) - kino kye mukago wakati w'enkola y'okumulisa n'obwetaavu bw'amaselo.

**D. Kebera eggrafu eraga enkyukakyuka mu busukali bw'omusaayi.**
- Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka naye si ku mukago wakati w'enzymes n'okumenyaamenya emmere.

**C**
D

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi be okuwa **endowooza ennyonnyofu** ku **nkola ezimu ez'okumanya ku butaffaali bw'ebiramu**.

Ekigendererwa kye kwe kuwa "endowooza ennyonnyofu" - kitegeeza okutandika okumanya, okwanjula, okufuna endowooza ez'awamu ku mulamwa guno.

Nneebera ku buli kirowoozo:

A. **Olulimi olulaga enkyukakyuka** - Kino kiwa abayizi endowooza ennyonnyofu ku nkola ez'okukoppa ebiramu, nga balaba enkyukakyuka eziibaddewo. Kino kisobozesa okumanya ku butaffaali.

B. **Pposita ku tekiniki** - Kino kikwata ku birime ebyakyusibwa, si ku butaffaali bw'ebiramu mu bujjuvu.

C. **Okunoonyereza okw'ekirowoozo ku bujjanjabi** - Kino kikwata ku bujjanjabi, si ku butaffaali bw'ebiramu mu bujjuvu.

D. **Omwoleso ku kukozesa stem cells** - Kino nakyo kikwata ku kuvumula endwadde, si ku butaffaali bw'ebiramu mu bujjuvu.

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku "nkola ez'okumanya ku butaffaali bw'ebiramu" - kino kitegeeza enkola ez'okuyiga engeri ebiramu gye bifaanana n'engeri gye byawukana (butaffaali).

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi bategeere enkola ya plasmolysis nga bayita mu kugezesa.

Plasmolysis ye nkola mwe selula z'ekimera zivaamu amazzi olw'osmosis nga ziri mu mazzi ag'omunnyoomungi (hypertonic solution). Kino kivaako selula okukala.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Ekijjanjalo mu mazzi ag'omunnyo** - Kino kiyinza okulaga plasmolysis kubanga amazzi ag'omunnyo gajja kuvaamu amazzi mu selula z'ekijjanjalo, ekijjanjalo ne kikala.

**B. Ennyama mu mazzi ag'omunnyo** - Ennyama si kimera, terina selula za kimera eziyinza okulaga plasmolysis mu ngeri ennuŋŋamu.

**C. Akaloozi mu mazzi ag'endulu** - Amazzi ag'endulu tegalina omunnyo mungi, kale kano kajja kulaga turgor (selula okujjula amazzi) so si plasmolysis.

**D. Eggi mu mazzi agasaliddwamu** - Eggi si kimera, era amazzi agasaliddwamu tegalina omunnyo, kale kino tekijja kulaga plasmolysis.

Ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kino: "Okunnyonnyola nti ebiramu bikolebwa obutoffaali obumu oba obusukka era nti buno butondekeddwa mu bitundu, ebitundu by'omubiri, n'enkola z'omubiri."

Ekigendererwa kino kyogera ku:
- Ebiramu bikolebwa obutaffaali (cells)
- Obutaffaali buno butondekeddwa mu: bitundu (parts) → ebitundu by'omubiri (tissues) → enkola z'omubiri (organ systems)

Kale nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Banannyonnyola obutaffaali bw'enkola ez'enjawulo - Kino kyogera ku nkola zokka, si ku ntegeka yonna okuva ku butaffaali okuyita mu bitundu n'ebitundu by'omubiri.

B. Bategeera nti buli akataffaali kava mu kataffaali akalala - Kino kyogera ku kuzaala kw'obutaffaali, si ku ntegeka y'okuzimba omubiri.

C. Zikola omukago wakati w'emitendera egy'enjawulo egy'entegeka y'ebiramu - Kino kyogera ku mitendera gy'entegeka (levels of organization) - obutaffaali → bitundu → ebitundu by'omubiri → enkola. Kino kikwatagana butereevu n'ekigendererwa.

D. Balaga enkolagana wakati w'obubeezi n'omuwendo - Kino kyogera ku bungi/obunene, si ku ntegeka y'okuzimba.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kya omusomesa kwe kusobozesa abayizi okutegeera nti ssaayansi **nkola ekyuka era ekolebwa abantu bonna okumala ekiseera** - kino kitegeeza okuyiga ku nkulaakulana y'endowooza za ssaayansi n'engeri endowooza bwe zikyusibwa olw'obukakafu obuggya.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Kola okunoonyereza ku bukakafu obuwagira enjigamannya y'ebipande by'ensi.**
- Kino kiyigiriza ku bukakafu obuwagira omulamwa oguli kaakano, naye tekiyigiriza ku nkyukakyuka y'essaayansi ng'enkola.

**B. Noonyereza ku ngeri omulamwa gwa plate tectonics gye gwazimbibwa.**
- Kino kiragisa ddala ku **nkulaakulana y'endowooza za ssaayansi okumala ekiseera** - engeri abantu bwe baanoonyereza, bwe baakuŋŋaanya obujulizi, n'engeri endowooza bwe zakyuka okutuuka ku kutegeera okwa kaakano. Kino kiragisa bulungi nti ssaayansi nkola ekyuka.

**C. Lwaki eyitibwa "omulamwa gw'ebipande by'ensi"?**
- Kino kikwata ku mannya, si ku nkulaakulana y'essaayansi.

**D. Noonyereza ku nkyukakyuka ezibaddewo mu kikuta ky'Ensi olw'obuyitiivu bw'ebipande by'Ensi.**
- Kino kiyigiriza ku bintu ebibaddewo ku nsi, naye si ku nkulaakulana y'essaayansi ng'enkola.

**B**

Nneekebejja enkola ey'okutegeka emirimu gino okuyiga ku ndabika y'akaziba:

**Enkola ennungi ey'okuyiga:**
- Okutandikira ku bintu ebyangu n'ebikulu (ebipimo by'omusingi)
- Okukulaakulanya okutuuka ku bintu ebizibuwavu (enkyukakyuka n'okugeraageranya)
- Okukozesa ebikozesebwa eby'enjawulo (okusoma, okukubaganya ebirowoozo, okukola)

**Nneekebejja buli nteekateeka:**

**1 - 3 - 4 - 2:**
- Okusoma ebiwandiiko (omusingi)
- Okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nkyukakyuka (enkulaakulana)
- Okugeraageranya (okukozesa okumanyiddwa)
- Okukola ebizibu (okukakasa okutegeera)

Eno egobera enkola ennungi: okutandikira n'omusingi (1), okukulaakulanya okutegeera (3), okukozesa okumanyiddwa (4), n'okukakasa n'ebizibu (2).

**B**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okutegeera enkola ey'okusomesa omulamwa gw'ekipimo ky'obubugumu eri abayizi b'ekibiina ekisoma.

## Okwekenneenya Ebyokuddamu:

**A. Amasoboza ag'ekinyetikki** - Kino kikwata ku nkola z'okukozesa ebyuma, naye si kye kisooka mu kutegeera omulamwa gw'ekipimo.

**B. Okutuukana kw'ebbugumu** - Kino kye kisooka! Abayizi balina okusooka okutegeera nti ebintu birina ebbugumu ery'enjawulo (ebimpi birina ebbugumu eritono, ebiwanvu birina ebbugumu ekinene) nga tebannagenda mu kukipima oba okukozesa ebikozesebwa.

**C. Okwewaguza kw'ebintu olw'ebbugumu** - Kino kijja oluvannyuma ng'abayizi bamaze okutegeera omulamwa gw'ebbugumu.

**D. Empeera z'okupima ebbugumu** - Kino nakyo kijja oluvannyuma, nga bamaze okutegeera omulamwa n'okutuukana.

Mu kusomesa, omusomesa ateekwa okusooka okuyigiriza **omulamwa** (concept) nga tannagenda mu bikozesebwa oba empeera. Abayizi balina okusooka okutegeera nti ebintu birina obuwanvu/ebbugumu ery'enjawulo.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ensonga enkulu eri nti abayizi bangi bakkiriziganya n'ekyo omusajja kye yakoze (okukuumira omuliro waggulu okufumba mangu). Kino kiraga nti balina endowooza enkyamu nti omuliro ogw'amaanyi gunnafumba nnuulu mangu.

Amazima g'ensayansi: Amazzi bwe gatuuka ku bbugumu ly'okubulukuka (100°C), ebbugumu lyaago telyongera kweyongera ne bw'oyongera amaanyi g'omuliro. Omuliro ogw'amaanyi gunnayanguya okubika, naye tegunnakendeeza budde bw'okufumba nnuulu oluvannyuma lw'okubika.

Tulowooza ku buli kikolwa:

A. Kunoonyereza ku ngeri ebbugumu ly'amazzi ery'okubulukuka gye likyuka - Kino tekituufu kubanga ebbugumu ly'okubulukuka telikyuka nnyo mu mbeera za bulijjo.

B. Okupima obudde kyetaagisa okwokya amazzi mu muliro ogw'amaanyi ag'enjawulo - Kino kiyamba okutegeera nti omuliro ogw'amaanyi guyanguya okubika, naye tekigatta ku nsonga y'okufumba.

C. Okuteesa enkola ey'okwekenneenya enkyukakyuka y'obwoki bw'amazzi nga bwe bukolebwako omuliro - Kino kiyinza okuba tekitegeerekeka bulungi.

D. Okwokya amazzi okutuusa lwe gabika, yongera amaanyi g'omuliro, era opime ebbugumu lyaago buli sikonda 30 okumala eddakiika 4 - Kino kiyamba abayizi okulaba nga ebbugumu telikyongera kweyongera oluvannyuma lw'okubika, wadde omuliro nga gw'amaanyi.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi **bateeketeeke okunoonyereza** okukwata ku maanyi agaleetera ekintu obutakulukuta. Abayizi balaba nti bwe bateeka ekipande ku mmeeza ne bagikyusa ku mpeto enjawulo, ekipande kitandika okuseerera.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kiki omusomesa kyakozesa **okukebera obanga abayizi batuuse ku kiruubirirwa**?

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A.** Kusaba abayizi okumanya ebintu ebikyuka n'okuteekateeka engeri y'okuwandiikaamu data - Kino kikwata ku **kutegeka** okunoonyereza, si kukebera oba batuuse ku kiruubirirwa.

**B.** Kubawe omukutu gw'okukozesa okukenkula obugulumivu... n'okubala avareegi - Kino kikwata ku **kukola** okunoonyereza n'okufuna data.

**C.** Okugamba abayizi okuteeka bulooka buli emu mu kifo ekigereke, bakyuse emmeeza okutuusa lw'esereerera, bapime engeli enoona gye yatandikidde - Kino **kikebera obanga basobola okukola okunoonyereza** n'okufuna ebipimo ebigereke.

**D.** Okubuuza abayizi okutegeera amakubo agayinza okukozesebwa okukakasa omukwano oguli wakati w'obwangaavu n'enjuyi gyekitandikirako okuseerera - Kino kikwata ku **kutegeera** n'**okwawula enkolagana** - ekyo kye kiruubirirwa ky'okunoonyereza.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukebera oba abayizi bategedde nti **obukakafu obw'ekikuguza bwe businga obukulu mu kuzimba okumanya**.

Kino kitegeeza nti ayagala okulaba oba abayizi bategedde nti obujulizi/obukakafu obufuniddwa mu kugezesa (empirical evidence) bwe businga obukulu okusinga ebirowoozo byereere.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

A. Okunnyonnyola obukakafu - kino kiragako bategeera obukakafu naye tekikakasa nti bategedde obukulu bwabwo mu kuzimba okumanya.

B. Okukola ebyawandiiko by'obujulizi - kino nakyo kiragako bakozesa obujulizi naye tekikakasa nti bategedde obukulu bwabwo.

C. **Okukola ebyawandiiko ebiraga engeri ebyo bye bakung'aanyizza gye bikwatagana n'ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza** - Kino kiragako abayizi basobola okulaga engeri obukakafu obwazuuliddwa bwe bukwatagana n'ekibuuzo, ekikakasa nti bategedde nti obukakafu bwe businga obukulu mu kuddamu ebibuuzo n'okuzimba okumanya.

D. Okukola enteekateeka - kino kiri mu mutendera gw'okutandikira, si kukebera okutegeera obukulu bw'obukakafu.

**C**

Nsomooza ekigendererwa ekikulu eky'okuyiga: "Kebejja era n'ovvuunula data okusobola okuwa obujulizi obuwagira ekirowoozo nti enjawulo y'ebiramu eva ku nkulaakulana y'ebiramu."

Ekigendererwa kino kyogera ku:
- Okukebera data
- Okuvvuunula data
- Okuwa obujulizi
- Okukwataganya enjawulo y'ebiramu n'enkulaakulana y'ebiramu

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okulonda ebimera okusinziira ku mitendera - kino kikwatagana n'okutegeerera ebika, naye tekikwatagana butereevu n'enkulaakulana y'ebiramu.

B. Okukwatagana kw'ebisigalira by'ebiramu eby'edda n'embeera - kino kikwatagana n'enkulaakulana y'ebiramu era kikozesa data okuwa obujulizi.

C. Okuva ku biwandiiko by'ebisigalira, teebereza enfaanana y'ekika - kino kikwatagana n'enkulaakulana naye tekikulu nnyo ku kukebera n'okuvvuunula data.

D. Okugerageranya ebikula ebirina obutonde bw'emu - kino kikwatagana n'okutegeerera obutonde, naye tekikwatagana butereevu n'enkulaakulana y'ebiramu.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okunnyonnyola **obukoleraano obutannatuukirira** (parasitism). Mu bukoleraano buno, omu aganyulwa ate omulala akosebwa.

Ka ntunuulire buli ky'okulaga:

**A. African hornbill n'ebiwuka:** Ekinyonyi kibeera n'ebiwuka mu kisu kyakyo, ebiwuka biriisa ku kazambi, ne biyamba ekinyonyi okuyoola kazambi. Kino **bukoleraano obw'omugaso** (mutualism) - byombi biganyulwa.

**B. Ensolo eziramula ne bakitiiriya:** Bakitiiriya mu byenda by'ensolo zikyusa selulosi, "ekiriisa kino ne kiba nti kigasa byombi." Kino **bukoleraano obw'omugaso** (mutualism) - byombi biganyulwa.

**C. Endagala z'emiti ku miti:** Endagala zekwata ku miti okufuna ekitangaala, amazzi, n'ebimera, "nga tebiziggya ku muti, omuti ogutakosebwa ndagala." Endagala ziganyulwa, omuti **gukosebwa** (gufiirwa ekitangaala, amazzi). Kino **bukoleraano obutannatuukirira** (parasitism).

**D. Obuwuka bwa Rhizobium:** Obuwuka bufuna ebiriisa okuva mu mirandira, ate era bukwasawaza nayitrogeni ebimera bye byetaaga. Kino **bukoleraano obw'omugaso** (mutualism) - byombi biganyulwa.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **fotosintesisi** n'ebintu ebigifuga. Ebimera bibiri biri mu mbeera ez'enjawulo:
- Ekimera A: ekitangaala kya kiragala
- Ekimera B: ekitangaala kya bbululu
- Byombi: mu kifo ekisibe, amazzi agenkana, tempulikya y'emu

Ebintu ebikulu eby'okufaayo:
1. Fotosintesisi yeetaaga ekitangaala
2. Ekitangaala kya bbululu n'ekya kiragala bye bitangaala ebisinga okukozesebwa mu fotosintesisi
3. Kkirolofiili ekwata ekitangaala kya bbululu n'ekya kiragala obulungi

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

**A**: Egamba kiragala kisinga - kino si kituufu nnyo kubanga bbululu n'ekitagala byombi bikulu

**B**: Egamba bbululu kisinga kubanga kkirolofiili ekwata ekitangaala kya bbululu obulungi - **Kino kituufu**. Kkirolofiili ekwata ekitangaala kya bbululu n'ekya kiragala obulungi ennyo, era bbululu y'emu ku mitala gy'ekitangaala egisinga okukozesebwa mu fotosintesisi.

**C**: Egamba tewali kimera kikula olw'okubulako CO₂ - kino si kituufu kubanga mu kifo ekisibe mulimu CO₂ okuva mu mpewo

**D**: Egamba byombi bikula kyenkanyi - kino si kituufu kubanga ekitangaala kya bbululu kisinga okuyamba

**B**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kino kyogera ku nkola y'okugezesa ekwatagana n'omukwano oguli wakati wa antigen ne antibody. Nneekenneenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Obutaffaali bwa B lwa lymphatic bukola obuzza bwa antibody obutalumiriza.**
- Kino tekituufu. B cells zikola antibodies ezilumiriza antigens.

**B. Ebipooli bikola okutereeza ekika ky'obutonde bw'omubiri obulwanyisa endwadde ekimu bwokka.**
- Kino tekituufu. T cells (si B cells) ze zikola okutereeza, era enkola y'okugezesa ya antigen-antibody tekwatagana nnyo n'ebipooli.

**C. Obuzimbe bw'omubiri bulina obusobozi okukolagana n'ekika kyonna ekya antijeni.**
- Kino kituufu! Antibodies zizimbibwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo (specific) okusobola okukolagana n'antigens ez'enjawulo. Buli antibody erina ekitundu ekimu ekikolagana n'antigen emu ennongoofu. Kino kye kigendererwa kya "lock and key model" - buli antibody (lock) erina antigen yaayo ey'enjawulo (key).

**D. Obutaffaali bwa B bufulumya ebika by'obutaffaali bw'omubiri obulwanyisa endwadde eby'enjawulo bwe buba biragiddwa ekika ky'akawuka akaleeta endwadde ekimu.**
- Kino tekituufu. Buli B cell ekolera antigen emu ennongoofu, si ebika by'enjawulo.

**C**
D

Nneekebeereza ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza nti: "Nkyukakyuka ki mu mubiri omukazi ze yandibadde nazo singa aweereddwa eddagala eriziyiza omulimu gwa GnRH?"

GnRH (Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone) ye hoomoni eva mu hypothalamus era ekola ku pituitary gland okukola hoomoni endala (LH ne FSH) ezikola ku ovaries.

Singa GnRH eziyizibwa:
- Pituitary gland tejja kukola LH ne FSH
- Ovaries tejja kufuna obubaka okukola estrogen ne progesterone
- Omutendera gw'ekizadde (menstrual cycle) gujja kuyimirira
- Buvubuka bujja kulemererwa okujja (mu baana)

Ekibuuzo kino kyebuuza ku:
- Omulandira gw'ebintu ebiddiring'ana (hormone cascade)
- Engeri hypothalamus, pituitary, n'ovaries gye zikwatagana
- Ebiva mu kuziyiza GnRH

Kino kikwatagana n'ekibuuzo **B** - "Nnyonnyola engeri omutwe gw'obwongo gye gufugaamu omusinde gw'ebisa eggi n'omubiri gw'ennyingo" - kubanga GnRH ye hoomoni enkulu eva mu hypothalamus (omutwe gw'obwongo) ekola ku pituitary ne gonads (ovaries).

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: okuyamba abayizi okukulaakulanya obusobozi bw'okutegeera **ebintu ebikyuka** mu kunoonyereza.

Ebintu ebikyuka (variables) mu kunoonyereza kwe kuba ebintu ebisobola okukyuka oba okwawukana era ebisobola okugezesebwa mu kunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okuzimba akakungunta k'essigala - kino kikwata ku kunoonyereza naye si ku bintu ebikyuka

B. Okuteekateeka ebyava mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa abayizi - kino kikwata ku kunoonyereza okwa ssosayiti naye si ku bintu ebikyuka mu kunoonyereza

C. Okutegeka omusingi ogw'ekibalangulo - kino kikwata ku data analysis naye si ku bintu ebikyuka

D. Okukola ebyokulabirako ebyazimbibwa abayizi ku **ngeri enzirukanya** y'eddagala erisindikiriza emikwanaganyo - "ngeri enzirukanya" (sequential process/steps) kino kiragisa **ebikyuka** (variables) nga bwe bikyuka mu nkola ey'okugoberera, era kino kiyamba abayizi okutegeera engeri ebintu gye bikyukamu.

**D**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kino kyogera ku musomesa ayagala abayizi okusiima ssaayansi nga **enkola ennywevu ey'okuzimba okumanya**. Asaba abayizi okukola olukalala lw'ebiseera nga balaga abasayansi abaddako be bakoze (Miescher, Feulgen, Levene, Griffith, Avery, Hershey, Chase).

Ekikulu wano kwe kulaga engeri **okumanya bwe kyazimbibwa mpola mpola** okuyita mu kunoonyereza kw'abasayansi ab'enjawulo mu biseera eby'enjawulo.

## Okwekenneenya Ebyokuddamu:

**A. Tegeera ebifaananyi ebiraga ebiseera eby'enjawulo eby'ekikyusizo ky'obutoffaali**
- Kino kyogera ku evolution, si ku nkulaakulana y'okuzuula DNA

**B. Nnyonnyola eb stages z'omugendo gw'amawulire g'obutonde**
- Kino kyogera ku gene expression (DNA → RNA → protein), si ku history y'okuzuula

**C. Nnyonnyola engeri DNA molecule gyefaanana**
- Kino kyogera ku structure ya DNA, si ku nkulaakulana y'okuzuula kwayo

**D. Vvuunula ebigezo ebiraga nti DNA ye molekyu etisse amawulire g'obusika**
- Kino **kiraga enkulaakulana y'okumanya** - engeri abasayansi bano bwe baakola okuva ku kuzuula nucleic acids (Miescher) okutuuka ku kukakasa nti DNA y'etwalira amawulire g'obusika (Hershey-Chase)

**D**

Nnekennenya enkola ey'okuva ku kyangu okudda ku kizibu mu bikolwa ebyo:

**Ekirowoozo 1: Kuteekawo ekiweebwa ky'omutendera gw'obutoffaali n'obubonero obugufuga**
- Kino kya bulijjo era kyangu - kuyiga ebintu ebikulu, amakulu, n'ebigambo

**Ekirowoozo 2: Okutegeera amakulu g'okweyongera kw'obungi bw'obutoffaali n'enkyukakyuka y'obutoffaali nga bakozesa eky'okuzannyisa**
- Kino kya wakati - kukozesa eky'okuzannyisa okutegeeramu amakulu

**Ekirowoozo 3: Okukwataganya omukono gw'obusirikale obukulu mu kufuga omutendera gw'obutoffaali ne mu bika bya kookolo**
- Kino kizibu ennyo - kukwataganya ebintu ebikulu n'okukola ensonga ez'omulembe ogw'amaanyi

Enkola ey'okuva ku kyangu okudda ku kizibu eba:
1 (kyangu - amakulu) → 2 (wakati - okuzannyisa) → 3 (kizibu - okukwataganya)

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa yabuuza abayizi ekibuuzo eky'okusooka: "Kiruwa ki ekyandibadde kya waggulu?" Bonna baddamu nti B.

Oluvannyuma abasaba:
1. Okukola omukolo okukakasa ekyo kye baalowoozezza
2. Okulambulula ebyavaamu
3. Okubigereranya n'endowooza zaabwe ezaaliwo

Kino kitegeeza nti omusomesa ayagala abayizi:
- Bakole ekyokulabirako (omukolo)
- Balabe ebyavaamu ebituufu
- Bagereranya ebyavaamu n'ekyo kye baali balowooza

Ekigendererwa ky'omukolo ogwokubiri kwe kugereranya ebyavaamu eby'okulabirako n'endowooza ezaaliwo, okukakasa oba okwawukanya endowooza ezaali zikyamu.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kino: "Okwekenneenya engeri y'ekitangaala gye kifaanana ng'obuntu obutini okusobola okunnyonnyola ebikolwa by'ekitangaala, nga tutegeera nti ebifaananyi birina emigaso gyabyo ate era n'obunafu bwabyo."

Ekikulu mu kigendererwa kino:
- Okwekenneenya engeri y'ekitangaala gye kifaanana ng'obuntu obutini (wave-like behavior)
- Okunnyonnyola ebikolwa by'ekitangaala
- Okutegeera emigaso n'obunafu bw'ebifaananyi

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okukyama kw'omusana nga guyita mu katuli akatono n'okukyusibwamu (polarization) - Bino byolesa obuntu obutini bw'ekitangaala, naye kikozesa "corpuscular model" ekitali kituufu ku kigendererwa.

B. Okugereranya endabika y'ekitangaala ekyejjulula n'ekisaasaana - Kikozesa "corpuscular model" naye ekigendererwa kyetaaga "wave model."

C. Okugereranya engeri omutanga ogw'ekitangaala gye gukyusibwamu - Kikozesa "corpuscular model" naye ekigendererwa kyetaaga "wave model."

D. Okugereranya engeri ebifaananyi gye bikolebwamu mu ndabirwamu enkovu ne mu lenti enkovu ng'okozesa emisingi gy'ebyobusirikale bw'ekitangaala (wave optics) - Kino kikozesa "wave model" era kigerageranya emigaso n'obunafu bw'ebifaananyi.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Okuyamba abayizi okutegeera engeri enteekateeka ya Copernicus ey'enjuba ey'omu makkati gye yavanga mu kunenyeza enteekateeka ya Ptolemy ey'ensi ey'omu makkati.

Nneebera buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Okugeraageranya endagiriro zombi nga bakozesa obufaananyi n'enjawulo - Kino kisobozesa abayizi okulaba lwatu enjawulo wakati w'endowooza zombi n'engeri enteekateeka ya Copernicus gye yavanga mu kunenyeza eya Ptolemy.

**B.** Okulaga olulimi olwa kompyuta - Kino kisobola okulaga entambula, naye tekikakasibwa nti kijja kulaga enjawulo wakati w'endowooza zombi oba engeri Copernicus gye yavanga mu kunenyeza Ptolemy.

**C.** Okulaga vidiyo y'enkulungo - Kino kiyinza okuyamba, naye enkulungo z'omu nsiisira y'enjuba si kigendererwa kikulu wano.

**D.** Okusoma ku "Enkyukakyuka ya Copernicus" - Kino kiyinza okuyamba, naye si mulimu ogw'okunoonyereza ogw'amaanyi nga bwe kiri mu birowoozo ebirala.

Ekiyanulo ekisinga obulungi kye **A** kubanga kisobozesa abayizi okugeraageranya n'okulaba lwatu enjawulo wakati w'endowooza zombi, ekisobozesa okutegeera engeri Copernicus gye yavanga mu kunenyeza Ptolemy.

**A**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku mulimu oguyamba abayizi **okwekenneenya omusingi gw'okukuuma amasoboza ag'ekinnakyinnya** (conservation of mechanical energy).

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

**A. Okwetegereza akapiira nga katambulira ku lubalama olwewunzise**
- Kino kiyamba okulaba enkyukakyuka mu maanyi g'obwangu n'amaanyi ag'obusobozi
- Abayizi basobola okwekenneenya engeri amaanyi bwe gakyukakyuka okuva ku potential energy okudda ku kinetic energy

**B. Okukwata embiro omupiira gwe gukubira ettaka**
- Kino kikwata ku "timing" okutali ku kwekenneenya omusingi gw'okukuuma amasoboza

**C. Okwetegereza obuwanvu omupiira bwe gutuuka waggulu ku katimba aka U**
- Kino kikwata ku kumpi n'okukuuma amasoboza naye si nnungi nnyo mu kwekenneenya

**D. Okukoppa kompyuta okw'ekizungirizi**
- Kino si kwekenneenya kwa bulijjo, kya tekinologiya okutali hands-on investigation

Ekirowoozo **A** kye kisinga obulungi kubanga:
- Kiwa abayizi omukisa okwekenneenya mu ngeri ey'amaanyi
- Balaba enkyukakyuka ez'amaanyi mu ngeri ey'obwereere
- Basobola okugezesa n'okukakasa omusingi gw'okukuuma amasoboza

**A**

Nze nnoonya okutegeera ekibuuzo kino obulungi.

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku bukugu bw'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi obusobola okukulaakulanyizibwa **obutereevu** okuyita mu mulimu guno ogw'okunoonyereza ku kintu ekigumu n'amateeka ga Hooke.

Mu mulimu guno, abayizi:
- Beekungaanya mu bibinja
- Banoonyereza ku kintu ekigumu
- Bawandiika ebyo bye bazuula mu mmeeza
- Banoonyereza ku bipimo by'amaanyi ebituufu (amateeka ga Hooke)
- Bateekateeka lipooti mu ngeri y'ekipande
- Bakireetebwa eri bannaabwe

Bwe ntunuulira ebyokulabirako:

A. Kunoonooza okunonyereza - kino kiyinza okubaawo naye si kye kikulu ennyo mu mulimu guno
B. Okufumbekera ebibuuzo - kino si kye kikulu wano kubanga ebibuuzo byabadde bimaze okuweebwa
C. Okunnyonnyola era olwanirire n'obukakafu mu bigambo ne mu buwandiike, nga mw'otwalidde emmeeza - **Kino kye kikulu ennyo** kubanga abayizi bawandiika ebyo bye bazuula mu mmeeza era bateekateeka lipooti ne bakireetebwa eri bannaabwe
D. Okuteekateeka enteekateeka z'okunoonyereza - kino nakyo kiyinza okubaawo naye si kye kikulu ennyo

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **etteeka lya Ohm** era omusomesa ayagala abayizi **okusemberera okussaawo amateeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika**.

Etteeka lya Ohm liraga omukwano wakati wa:
- Voltisi (V)
- Amaanyi g'amasannyalaze/Current (I)  
- Obuzibu/Resistance (R)

Okusemberera okussaawo etteeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza, abayizi balina:
1. Okukuŋŋaanya data (ebipimo)
2. Okulaba enkyukakyuka
3. Okuzuula omukwano
4. Okukola ggulaafu
5. Okusemberera okussaawo etteeka

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

Okwetegereza enkola ey'okuyigiriza:
- Abaana basaanye okusooka okutegeera **ebintu** nga bwe biri (their properties)
- Oluvannyuma ne bayiga engeri **ebintu gye bikyukakyuka** bwe bikozesebwako amaanyi, amazzi, ebbugumu, n'ekitangaala

Nga tuntunuulira ebyokulabirako mu bibuuzo ebisooka:
- Abaana basooka okuyiga **obubonero bw'ebintu** (properties) nga langi, obunene, obuwewufu
- Oluvannyuma ne bayiga **enkyukakyuka** mu bintu

Kale, omusomesa asaanye okusooka okuyigiriza abaana **ebintu ebikulu** (properties) ebikwata ku maanyi, ekitangaala, ebbugumu, n'amazzi nga tannaba kwogera ku **nkyukakyuka** zaabyo.

A. Kunnyonnyola mu bigambo - kino si kulaga mu ngeri ey'amaanyi, kya theory

D. Kulaga ekisiikirizo eky'ebbulbuzi nnya mu parallel n'ekirala mu series - kino kisobozesa omuyizi **okulaba** mu ngeri ey'amaanyi enjawulo wakati wa series (amasannyalaze gaggwaamu) ne parallel (amasannyalaze tegaggwaamu bwe gatyo)

Ekikolwa ekisoomooza butereevu endowooza y'omuyizi kwe kulaga mu ngeri ey'amaanyi enjawulo wakati w'enkola zombi.

Enkyamu mu kuddamu kuno eri mu kutegeera engeri natural selection bw'ekola.

Ebiwuka tebyakulaakulanya obukuumi nga kibinja oluvannyuma lw'okurondoosebwa DDT. Wabula, ebiwuka ebimu byalina enjawulo ez'obutonde (genetic variations) ezaabiganyanga DDT, era ebyo bye byawonye ne bizaala abaana. Enjawulo zino zaaliwo dda, si nti zakulaakulanyizibwa olw'okurondoosebwa.

B. Kino kituufu - kino nayo nkola ya natural selection
C. **Kino si kituufu** - kino kyogera nti abantu "balina okukulaakulanya" enkola - kino kye kibuusabuusa ekiri mu kuddamu kw'omuyizi
D. Kino kituufu - kino nayo nkola ya natural selection

Enkyamu mu kuddamu kw'omuyizi eri mu kulowooza nti ebiwuka "byakulaakulanya" obukuumi nga kigendererwa, nga bwe kiri mu C.

- Entabaganyi n'okweyawulamu kw'obutoffaali (3)
- Okusala amagulu/Crossing-over (1)
- Okukyusa endaga butonde (2)

**D.** Omukolo n'omwanaaluli - Kino kiragisa ebika by'obutoffaali n'engeri gye buzimbibwamu, naye tekikakasa nnyo ku nkola enkyukakyuka ey'okuzimba okumanya.

2. Okukuŋŋaanya ebirowoozo ku lubaawo

B. Ebintu ebikulu - Omusomesa yawa ebintu (bbaluuni, empapula, olugoye, ruler) era yalagira engeri y'okubikozesa
C. Obukenkufu mu kulowooza - Omusomesa yasaba abayizi "okuwa endowooza n'okuwandiika bye balabye" era "okunnyonnyola okukkiriziganyiziddwaako"
D. Okukenkufu tekukwataganyizibwa na birumirwa ebyayita - Omusomesa yatandika n'okubuuza ku ntandikwa y'amasannyalaze (ebirowoozo ebyayita) era yakuŋŋaanya eby'okuddamu ku lubaawo

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa yateekawo ekibalangulo: x = 25 + 40t - 5t²

- Ku t=6s: omubiri gutambudde mita 85

Leka nkebere ekituufu:

Ku t=5s: x(5) = 25 + 40(5) - 5(5)² = 25 + 200 - 125 = 100 mita
Ku t=6s: x(6) = 25 + 40(6) - 5(6)² = 25 + 240 - 180 = 85 mita

Abayizi baakola obubalo obw'obutuufu! Naye omusomesa agamba nti tebategeera nti "omubiri gutambudde obuwanvu butono mu kiseera kiwanvu."

Obuwanvu obwatambulwa = x(6) - x(5) = 85 - 100 = -15 mita

Abayizi baawadde ebipimo bya position (100 ne 85) naye si displacement wakati w'ebiseera ebyo.

Ekizibu kyabwe si kubala (kubanga baakola obubalo obw'obutuufu), wabula **obutategeera nnyingo** - okwawula wakati wa "position" ne "displacement" - ekikulu mu kinemaatika.

- Okudda ku bintu ebikalu, ebinywevu, n'ebeetaaga okutegeera okw'amaanyi (bikalu/complex)

Nnekennenya buli kikolwa:

1. **Okubala ebbugumu eriyimbibwa ekintu** - Kino kya bulijjo, kirabika, era kyangu okukola
2. **Okupima n'okugeraageranya obwoki** - Kino nakyo kya bulijjo era kirabika

4. **Okubala obusobozi bw'okuyimiriza ebbugumu** - Kino kikalu ennyo, kinywevu, era kyetaaga okutegeera okw'amaanyi

Omulandira ogutuufu: 2 (bulijjo) → 1 (bulijjo) → 3 (wakati) → 4 (kikalu)

**B. 1 - 3 - 4 - 2**? Nedda.

**D. 4 - 2 - 1 - 3**? Nedda.

Nze nnesuubira omulandira: 2 → 1 → 3 → 4, naye kino tekiri mu birowoozo. Leka nddemu:

Omulandira ogutuufu: **1 - 2 - 3 - 4** (okubala → okupima → okutegeera → okubala obusobozi)

Mu birowoozo: **B** (1-3-4-2) oba **C** (2-3-1-4)

Nneekenneenya buli kirowoozo:

**B.** Wandiika omwoleso - Kino kikwata ku kuwandiika, si ku kusobola okulonda amawulire ag'obwesigwa.

**C.** Teebereza akataambi - Kino kya presentation skills, si critical evaluation skills.

**D.** Sengeka emikutu okutandika n'ogusinga okwesigika okudda ku gusinga obuteesigika, ng'olambulula ebipimo ebyakozeseddwa - Kino **kyennyini** kiyigiriza abayizi okwawula n'okusalawo ku bwesigwa bw'ensibuko z'amawulire, era balambulula lwaki - ekyo kye kigendererwa ekikulu.

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

4. Okukulaakulanya tekinologiya aganyula abantu
5. Okuzimba ebimera ebikozesa amaanyi ga nyukiriya

Ekibuuzo kibuuza: Mulimu ki omuyizi gw'ayinza okutuukako?

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

B. Okutegeera okumanya okwa ssaayansi okw'obusirikale bw'akaziba - kino kikwata ku nkola y'okumanya naye si kye kigendererwa kikulu

C. Okwagala okukwataganya okusoma ku nnyukiriyaasi n'ebintu ebya bulijjo - kino kikwata ku kwagala okusoma naye si kye kigendererwa kikulu

D. Okunyonyola engeri amaanyi gye gaggibwa mu nnyuklia y'akaziba n'engeri gye gasobola okukyusibwamu okufuuka amasannyalaze - Kino kye kigendererwa kikulu ekyogerwako mu mulimu: okufuna amasannyalaze okuva mu busibe bw'akaziba

**D**

- Okunnyonnyola ebikolwa by'omusana
- Okuyita mu kugezesa n'okukozesa engero
- Okulowooza ku ngero z'obusirikale n'amayengo

Nkebera buli kyokulabirako:

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa asaba abayizi okuzimba akabonero akalaga omuteeko gw'Ensi n'Omwezi nga buli kimu kyenkana era balage engeri enjuba gy'ekusirikiramu nga bakozesa ekitangaala ky'ekyuma ekiraga ebifaananyi.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Gumu ku mirimu gino gubasobozesa okukebera obutegeevu bwabwe ku ngeri enjuba gy'ekusirikiramu?

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Balaga nti Ensi, Omwezi, n'Enjuba bibeera mu luse olugolokofu - Kino kikwata ku muteeko w'ebintu bino, naye si nnyo ku ngeri enjuba gy'ekusirikiramu.

B. Bannyonnyola nti ekisi ky'enjuba kibaawo omwezi bwe gusuula ekisiikirize kyagwo ku ttaka - Kino si kituufu. Ekisi ky'enjuba kibaawo Omwezi bwe gubeera wakati w'Enjuba n'Ensi ne gusuula ekisiikirize kyagwo ku Nsi.

C. Balaga engeri omwezi gye gutambuliramu nga gwekulungulula ensi - Kino kikwata ku ntambula y'omwezi, naye si nnyo ku ngeri enjuba gy'ekusirikiramu.

D. Bakola akabonero omwolesebwa omuwendo wakati w'Ensi n'Omwezi n'obunene bwabyo - Kino kikwata ku bunene n'ebanga, naye si nnyo ku ngeri enjuba gy'ekusirikiramu.

Nga bwe basaba okukozesa ekitangaala ky'ekyuma mu kifo ky'Enjuba, ekigendererwa kikulu kwe kulaga engeri ekitangaala bwe kikwata ku Nsi n'Omwezi - ekyo kye kisiikirize ky'enjuba.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukebera obusobozi bw'abayizi **okutegeka ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi** okugenderera okumanya ebintu ebyeyambisibwa okuleetera ekintu okubuguma.

Ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi kirina okubeera:
- Ekibuuzo ekiyinza okugezesebwa
- Ekisobola okwetegerezebwa n'okupimibwa
- Ekikwatagana n'enkyukakyuka eziyinza okukebererwa

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulonda:

**A**: Bakola okunoonyereza okuteekawo ebintu... - Kino kikwata ku **kutegeka okunoonyereza** n'okuteekawo enkyukakyuka (ebintu eby'enjawulo, obuzito, enkula). Kino kya bulijjo kye kutegeka ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza.

**B**: Bakunganya ebipimo... - Kino kikwata ku **kukunganya data** n'okwetegereza, si kutegeka ekibuuzo.

**C**: Bakozesa obukakafu... - Kino kikwata ku **kunnyonnyola ebiva** n'okuzimba ensonga, si kutegeka ekibuuzo.

**D**: Bakola ekirowoozo ekikeberebwa... - Kino kikwata ku **kutegeka hypothesis** n'enteekateeka y'okugezesa, naye si kutegeka ekibuuzo ery'okunoonyereza.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okulaga nti okumanya mu kemisitule:
- kukulakulana (kwakyukakyuka)
- kwa maanyi 
- kujjudde empaka

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Empaka z'ebiteeso by'enzimbulukusa y'akaziba**
- Kino kiragisa empaka ez'ebyafaayo - nga abantu bwe baawukana ku ntegeera

**B. Teekawo lipoota y'okunoonyereza ku musingi gwa VSEPR**
- Kino kya teknikaali nnyo, si kulaga empaka n'enkyukakyuka mu byafaayo

**C. Empaka z'okulaga amateeka g'ebinyonyi**
- Kino kikwata ku biology, si kemisitule

**D. Nnongeza y'ebivuddeko eby'ebyafaayo by'endowooza y'okwegatta**
- Kino kiragisa nga ebyafaayo byakyukakyuka (ebivuddeko eby'enjawulo)
- Kiragisa enkyukakyuka mu ndowooza (ebyafaayo eby'ebyafaayo)
- Kiragisa empaka mu kemisitule

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Abayizi balowooza nti emmunnyu zombi (NaCl ne NaHCO3) zisaanuuka mu mazzi mu ngeri y'emu. Naye oluvannyuma lw'ekiigezo, bazuula nti tezirina busaanuufu bwe bumu.

Enkyamu y'abayizi eri mu kulowooza nti:
- Olw'okuba emmunnyu zombi zisaanuuka mu mazzi (nga ziva mu solid state okudda mu aqueous ions)
- Kino kitegeeza nti zisaanuuka mu ngeri y'emu

Naye amazima ge gali nti:
- Okusaanuuka kw'emmunnyu si kye kimu bwekityo
- Busaanuufu bw'emmunnyu businziira ku nkola y'omukago wakati wa molekyu za munnyo n'amazzi (ekinyunguluzi)
- Emmunnyu ez'enjawulo zirina emikago egy'enjawulo n'amazzi, kale ne zisaanuuka mu ngeri ez'enjawulo

Ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **birowoozo ebikyamu** (misconceptions) abayizi bye baba nabyo ku **bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi** (non-spontaneous processes) mu thermodynamics.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Abayizi balowooza nti okweyongera mu bwetaavu (entropy) kiyamba mu kwetereera.**
- Kino kikyamu kubanga mu bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi, entropy y'ensi yonna eyinza okukendeera (okugwa), naye kino kyetaaga amasoboza okuva ebweru. Abayizi batera okufuuka nga balowooza nti entropy bulijjo yeyongera, naye kino si kituufu mu bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi.

**B. Abayizi bagamba nti ebintu ebitayinza kulemesa nkola za butonde bisobola okuba nga byeyongera okwewooya.**
- Kino si kirowoozo ekikyamu ekya bulijjo.

**C. Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebigenda nga byokka na bwabyo bigenda mangu nnyo.**
- Kino kyogera ku spontaneous processes, si non-spontaneous.

**D. Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebyetereera byesigama ku bwoki n'okusaasaanya amasoboza.**
- Kino kituufu, si kirowoozo kikyamu.

Ekibuuzo ekituufu kye:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **etteeka lya Hund** erikwata ku **bungi obusinga obuyinza okubaawo** bw'elekitulooni mu orbital.

Etteeka lya Hund ligamba nti: Elekitulooni zijjuza orbital ez'amasannyalaze ag'emu nga buli emu esooka okuyingira mu orbital ey'enjawulo nga ziri n'obusannyalaza obumu (parallel spins) nga zitannakozesa orbital kimu bbiri.

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A.** Endagiriro z'obusannyalaza ez'atomi mu mbeera ey'ettaka - Kino kiyinza okulaga etteeka lya Hund.

**B.** Empandiika ya elekitulooni mu mbeera ey'obutebenkevu - Kino tekikwatagana nnyo ne etteeka lya Hund.

**C.** Okugeraageranya okusaasaanya kw'obusannyalaza mu dayagulaamu z'obusa - Kino **kituufu ddala** kubanga etteeka lya Hund likwata ku ngeri elekitulooni gye zisaasaanyizibwa mu orbital ez'amasannyalaze ag'emu, era dayagulaamu z'obusa (orbital diagrams) ze zikozesebwa okulaga kino.

**D.** Okukenenula endabika y'amasannyalaze ag'ebweru - Kino kikwata ku mbeera ez'enjawulo naye si nnyo ku etteeka lya Hund.

**C**

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino mu ngeri ey'omutindo:

Omulimu guno gukwata ku:
- Ebintu bitaano eby'enjawulo (omunnyo, essukaali, bicarbonate, amafuta, omwenge)
- Byongeddwa mu mazzi ag'endulu
- Abayizi basabiddwa okunnyonnyola lwaki ebimu biwulukuka, ebirala bitundu, ate ebirala tebiwulukuka

Kino kye kibuuzo ekikwata ku **kusaanuuka** (solubility) - engeri ebintu eby'enjawulo gye ziyinza okuwulukuka mu mazzi.

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

**A**: Kino kyogera ku bintu ebya polaa ne ebitali bya polaa - kino kituufu nnyo kubanga amazzi ga polaa, omunnyo/essukaali/bicarbonate bya polaa (bisaanuuka), ate amafuta/omwenge bitali bya polaa oba bitundu (tebisaanuuka bulungi).

**B**: Kino kyogera ku "kiyuusizo ekitali kya kibiebie" - kino tekikwatagana bulungi n'omulimu.

**C**: Kino kyogera ku maanyi ga molekyu - kino kya ssaayansi ennyo naye si kigendererwa kikulu eri abayizi ba siniya.

**D**: Kino kyogera ku "obuziba" (density) - naye omulimu tegukwata ku buziba wabula ku kusaanuuka.

Ekiyanulo ekisinga okutuukirira kye:

**A**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekigendererwa: Okuyamba abayizi okutegeera enjawulo mu mitendera gy'enkolagana wakati wa molekyu era n'okukulaakulanya obukugu mu bya ssaayansi.

Nneekenneenya buli kikolwa:

- Kino kikwata ku nkola z'omunda, si ku mitendera gy'enkolagana wakati w'obuziba

**B. Okukola maapu y'endowooza nga basinziira ku kusoma**
- Kino kikwata ku kusoma n'okutegeerera, naye si kukola mu bya ssaayansi oba okugezesa

**C. Okwekenneenya obubaawo bw'enkolagana wakati w'ebintu ebiri mu molekyu**
- Kino kikwata ku kwekenneenya, naye si kukola okugezesa oba okukozesa obukugu bwa ssaayansi

**D. Okukola enteekateeka y'okugezesa okuzuula obukakafu**
- Kino kikulaakulanya obukugu bwa ssaayansi (okuteekawo enteekateeka, okugezesa)
- Kizuula obukakafu bw'engeri z'enkolagana (ekigendererwa)
- Kikozesa enkola ya ssaayansi

Nga twetegereza enkola mu bibuuzo ebisooka (abayizi bakola, bagezesa, bakenneenya), ekikolwa ekituufu kye:

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi okutegeera nti ensolo ezimu zifaanagana mu ndabika, ekizisobozesa okuteekebwa mu kibinja kye kimu.

Ekikulu wano kwe **kwawula** (classify/categorize) ensolo okusinziira ku **ndabika ezifaanagana**.

Ka ntunuulire buli kikolwa:

A. Lambulula empisa ezirabika - Kino kikwata ku kulambulula, si kwawula mu bibinja
B. Gattika ebifaananyi by'ensolo okusinziira ku kika ky'ekibikka omubiri gwazo - Kino kikwata ku **kwawula** ensolo mu bibinja okusinziira ku **ndabika ezifaanagana** (ekibikka omubiri)
C. Loba ensolo okusinziira ku birungo ebiweereddwa - Kino si kwawula okusinziira ku ndabika ezifaanagana, wabula ku birungo ebiweereddwa
D. Lagaanye ensolo n'ekifo we zibeera - Kino kikwata ku matching, si kwawula mu bibinja

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kunoonyereza okw'okugezesa okukwata ku byetaago by'ebimera (amazzi). Omusomesa akozesa:
- Bbeki 3 ez'ettaka lye limu
- Ensigo ze muwendo gwe gumu
- **Enkyukakyuka ey'okugezesa**: omuwendo gw'amazzi (omulundi gumu buli lunaku, omulundi gumu buli wiiki, emirundi ebiri buli wiiki)
- Ebintu ebirala byonna bikuumibwa nga bya kika kimu

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kiki ekiraga nti abayizi basobole okufuna ennamalirizo ezikwatagana n'**okintu ekikyuka** (variable)?

Nnekennenya buli ky'okuddamu:

A. Banuunula omusana n'ebimera by'omu mazzi - Kino tekikwatagana n'ekintu ekikyuka mu kugezesa

B. Balaga ebiriisa amazzi bye gawa ebimera okukula - Kino kikwatagana n'ekintu ekikyuka (omuwendo gw'amazzi) era kiraga enkyukakyuka mu kukula okusinziira ku muwendo gw'amazzi ogw'enjawulo

C. Bye basalawo omuwendo gw'amazzi - Kino kya "kusalawo" si kuva mu kugezesa

D. Banannyonnyola omulimu gw'emirandira - Kino tekikwatagana n'ekintu ekikyuka

**B**

Nneekebeereza ekibuuzo kino n'obwegendereza:

Omusomesa abasaba:
1. Okusooka okusiiga ekifaananyi ky'ekyo bye balowooza kigenda okubaawo (prediction/hypothesis)
2. Okukola okunoonyereza (okugenda okwetagisa okuteeka akakunkumuka k'omuzira ku musana)
3. Okusiiga ekifaananyi eky'ekyo kye balabye ddala nga kibaddewo
4. **Okunnyonnyola engeri ebifaananyi ebyo ebiri gye bifaanagana era gye byawukanira**
5. Okwogera ku oba ekyo kye baalowooza kyabaddewo ddala

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku bukugu bwa ssaayansi ekiragibwa mu **kufundikira** kw'omukolo - ekyo kwe kugamba mu kutandika n'okumaliriza.

Mu kufundikira, abaana:
- Balinnyisa ebifaananyi bibiri (ekyo kye baalowooza n'ekyo kye balabye)
- Balaba engeri gye bifaanagana n'engeri gye byawukanira
- Balinnyisa ebyalowoozebwa n'ebituufu

Kino kye **Okugeraageranya** (Comparing) - okulaba okufaanana n'okwawukana wakati w'ebintu bibiri oba ebisingawo.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kutegeera engeri ebbugumu gye liyitamu okuva ku kintu ekimu okudda ku kirala. Abayizi baalina okutegeera nti engoye enzigumu zikozesebwa okusigaza akabugumu kubanga zikendeeza omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu.

Nnekennenya buli kikolwa:

**A.** Okukwata ebintu eby'enjawulo n'okupima tempulikya yaabyo - kino kiyamba okutegeera nti ebintu birina tempulikya ez'enjawulo, naye tekiyolesa bulungi engeri ebbugumu gye liyitamu.

**B.** Okukulukuta kw'ebbugumu wakati w'ebikopo bibiri eby'amazzi ebirina tempulikya ez'enjawulo, ng'ekimu kibikkiddwa mu byoya by'endiga - kino kiyolesa bulungi engeri ebyoya (ng'engoye enzigumu) bwe bikendeeza omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu wakati w'ebintu bibiri ebirina tempulikya ez'enjawulo.

**C.** Okupima obudde amazzi bwe gatwala okutuuka ku tempulikya emu mu mbeera ez'enjawulo - kino kiyolesa okutambula kw'ebbugumu naye si mu ngeri ey'enjawulo ennyo.

**D.** Okubikka ebikwaso ku muliro n'okupima tempulikya - kino kiyolesa okutambula kw'obwokya naye si mu ngeri ey'okuyigiriza abayizi ku ngoye enzigumu.

Ekikolwa **B** kye kisinga okukwatagana n'okutegeera kw'abayizi nti engoye zikendeeza omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu, era kiyolesa bulungi engeri ebbugumu gye liyitamu.

**B**

# Nkola y'Okusalawo

Kino kibuuzo kikwata ku ngeri omusomesa gy'ayinza okwanukula ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi mu ngeri ennyangu, ey'obwesimbu mu bya ssaayansi, era egwanira omutendera gw'essomero ogwogeddwako (ekibiina ky'omunaana).

Omuyizi abuuza: "Kiki ekibaawo ku bimera bwe biba tebifukirirwa ne bikala?"

Nkebera buli nnyonyola:

**A:** Ekozesa ebigambo ebya ssaayansi ebizibuwavu ennyo nga "plasmolysis" - kiyinza okuba ekizibuwavu nnyo eri abayizi b'ekibiina ky'omunaana.

**B:** Ennyonyola eno nnyangu nnyo era tekozesa bigambo bya ssaayansi ebikulu. Naye ennyonyola eno si nnuŋŋamu - egamba nti emmunnyu egenda okuva munda okudda ebweru, naye mu mazima amazzi ge gava munda okudda ebweru.

**C:** Ennyonyola eno si nnuŋŋamu mu mbeera eno. Egamba nti amazzi gava ebweru okudda munda, naye mu mbeera ya hypertonic solution (amazzi aganywevu), amazzi gava munda okudda ebweru.

**D:** Ennyonyola eno nnuŋŋamu era ennyangu. Ennyonnyola bulungi nti:
- Ebintu ebiri ebweru bifuuka bya mugattiko munene
- Amazzi gava munda okudda ebweru
- Obutaffaali bukendezaamu obunene
- Akakoola kalabika ng'agootedde

Eno y'ennyonyola ennyangu, ennuŋŋamu era egwanira abayizi b'ekibiina ky'omunaana.

**D**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino ekikwata ku kiruubirirwa eky'okuyiga enkola y'okugemebwa ekolebwa eddagala erigema.

Okusobola okutegeera enkola y'okugemebwa ekolebwa eddagala erigema, abayizi balina okutegeera engeri omubiri gye gukola okwewakanya n'obulwadde. Eddagala erigema lirina antigens ezitono oba ezisaasaanyiziddwa eziyamba omubiri okukola antibodies n'okujjukira obulwadde obwo.

Ekiruubirirwa kino kyetaaga okutegeera:
- Engeri omubiri gye gukola okwewakanya n'obulwadde
- Enkola y'antibodies n'antigens
