Ekigendererwa: Abayizi balage engeri enkyukakyuka ezibaawo mu busirikale bw'obuziba obwa leediyoaktifu gye zikwatagana n'obugumu bwabwo.

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga abayizi:
- Okulaga enkyukakyuka mu busirikale bw'obuziba obwa leediyoaktifu
- Okukwataganya enkyukakyuka zino n'obugumu bw'obuziba

Nneekenneenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okukiikirira ebifulumizibwa bya nuclide mu nkulukuta - Kino kiyamba okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu busirikale naye tekikwataganya bulungi n'obugumu.

B. Okutegeera ekika ky'ekifulumizibwa nga basinziira ku ggulaafu y'omusipi gw'obunywevu - Kino kikwataganya obugumu (omusipi gw'obunywevu) n'enkyukakyuka mu busirikale bw'obuziba.

C. Okunoonyereza ku maanyi - Kino kikwata ku maanyi, si ku nkyukakyuka mu busirikale.

D. Okuteekateeka akatonnyeze - Kino kalaga ebika by'obusannyalaze naye tekikwataganya bulungi n'obugumu.

Ekiyanulo ekituufu:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kiri "Okwekenneenya enkyukakyuka mu bungi bw'ebintu ebikola ekintu n'ebivaamu mu kikolwa ky'obuziizi"

Ekizibu: Abayizi basoma bubi ekibalangulo ekikwata ku muwendo gw'enkalakkalira ogw'ekyenkanyi.

Omusomesa yeetaaga ekibuuzo ekiyamba abayizi:
- Okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu bungi
- Okukozesa ekibalangulo obulungi

Nnekennenya buli kibuuzo:

A. Ensibuko y'ekifo abazimba n'ebivaamu we bitandikira - Kino kikwata ku ntandikwa yokka, si ku nkyukakyuka

B. Obungi bwabwo ku ntandikwa - Kino kikwata ku ntandikwa yokka, si ku nkyukakyuka

C. Ddi ebintu birekera awo okukozesebwa ate ebiva ne birekera awo okubaawo - Kino kikwata ku budde/ekiseera, era kiyamba okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu bungi okuyita mu budde (nga bwe kiragibwa ku kibalangulo)

D. Waliwo obuteeyongerayo - Kino kibuuza ku kukolebwa n'okukozesebwa, si ku nkyukakyuka mu bungi

Ekibuuzo ekisinga okuyamba abayizi okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu bungi nga bakozesa ekibalangulo kiri:

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa alina ekizibu: abayizi bazimba olukoloboze lw'ekigeranyo ky'okugattika asidi n'ebbesi, naye bafuna omuwendo gwa pH omubi oluvannyuma lw'ekifo ky'obwenkanyi.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Omusomesa andikozesezza mulimu ki okuluŋŋamya abayizi okumaliriza okuzimba olukoloboze?

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

A. Kutwala abayizi mu labolatoli - Kino tekiyamba nnyo kubanga ekizibu si kukosa mu nkola, wabula okutegeera engeri y'okuzimba olukoloboze.

B. Okunnyonnyola ekipimo kya pH - Kino kiyinza okuyamba, naye si kye kintu ekikulu ekiyamba okuzimba olukoloboze.

C. Okunnyonnyola, nga nkuwa eky'okulabirako, engeri y'okumanya omuwendo gw'obuziba obusukkulumu - Kino kye kintu ekikulu! Abayizi bafuna pH omubi oluvannyuma lw'ekifo ky'obwenkanyi kubanga tebamanyi ngeri y'okubala obuziba obusukkulumu bwa asidi oba bbeesi mu bitundu eby'enjawulo eby'okugattika.

D. Okukozesa pulogulaamu kompyuta - Kino kiyinza okuyamba, naye si kye kiyigiriza abayizi okutegeera ensonga.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa alina ekizibu: abayizi tebaategeera bulungi nti mu nkola za kemiko, obungi bw'ebintu ebikolawo n'ebivaamu bubeera bwe bumu (etteeka ly'okukuumibwa kw'obungi/mass conservation).

Ekibuuzo kyabwe: "Ebintu ebikolawo n'ebivaamu bituuka ku butebenkevu byokka byokka?"

Omusomesa yeetaaga okubayamba okutegeera nti obungi bw'ebintu bubeera bwe bumu nga tebukyuka.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Kulaga omuwendo - kino kiyinza okuyamba naye si kya bulijjo nnyo ku kutegeera okukuumibwa kw'obungi

B. Kulaga ebiri ku mutendera ogw'obunene n'obutono - kino kikwata ku nkola naye si kya bulijjo ku kutegeera okukuumibwa kw'obungi

C. Enkola y'okugezesa eraga engeri ebintu ebiyinza okutaataganya embeera - kino si kituufu, kubanga mu kemiko obungi tebwetaataganya

D. Enkola y'okugezesa ekusobozesa okubala obungi bw'ebintu nga tebikyuka okusinziira ku bungi bwabyo bwe byatandise - kino kituufu ddala! Kino kiyigiriza etteeka ly'okukuumibwa kw'obungi mu nkola za kemiko.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa akola omukolo gw'okugezesa ebbugumu n'enkyukakyuka zaakyo. Abayizi balaba nti mu kiseera kyonna (eddakiika 60), bbaafu teerisaanuuke n'amazzi agabidde teganaannyogoga nga obudde bwa diguli 20°C.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga kuleetera abayizi **okuddamu okulowooza** ku kirowoozo kyabwe okuva mu bumanyirivu buno.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Obubonero bw'obudde bukosa butya enkola y'entegeka? - Kino kiyinza okuyamba naye si kya musingi nnyo mu kino.

B. Obupimiro bw'ebbugumu bukwatagana butya n'enkola enteekateeka? - Kino kiyinza okuyamba okutegeera naye si kya musingi mu kuddamu okulowooza ku kirowoozo kyabwe.

C. Lwaki emirundi mingi twogera ku bintu ebyokya n'ebinyogoga, mu ngeri eno, ku kacaali omunyogovu ne kacaali omwokya? - Kino **kibuuza lwaki** abayizi balowooza nti bbaafu terisaanuuke (teerikya) n'amazzi teganaannyogoga (teganyogoga). Kino kibaduusa okulowooza ku nsonga lwaki balowooza bw'atyo, era kiyinza okubatuusa ku kutegeera nti ebbugumu litambula okuva ku kintu ekikya okudda ku ekinyogoga.

D. Enjawulo eri wakati w'obwoki bw'embeera n'obwoki bw'ebintu - Kino kya ssaayansi naye si kya musingi mu kino.

Ekibuuzo ekisinga okuleetera abayizi okuddamu okulowooza ku kirowoozo kyabwe kye **C**.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibiina kya siniya 3 beetegekera lipooti ku "Ebintu Ebikosa Embiro y'Enkyukakyuka" (factors affecting rate of change).

Okusobola okunnyonnyola ebyava mu kigezo ekyo, abaana basooka okumanya:

- **A. Etteeka ly'omuwendo gw'ekikolwa** - Kino kikwata ku muwendo/amount w'ekikolwa
- **B. Omulamwa gw'obutomera** - Kino kikwata ku kutomera/germination
- **C. Okunnyonnyola omugatte ogw'enkalubo y'obutonde** - Kino kikwata ku nkalubo/cycle y'obutonde
- **D. Ebintu ebikosa obwangu bw'ekikolwa ky'obutonde** - Kino kikwata ku factors ezikosa embiro/rate y'enkyukakyuka

Okwogera ku "embiro y'enkyukakyuka" (rate of change), abaana basooka okumanya ebintu ki ebikosa obwangu bw'ekikolwa ky'obutonde - kino kye kigendererwa kya lipooti yaabwe.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omulimu oguweereddwa abayizi guzingiramu:
1. Okuwandiika endagabuteezi enzijuvu ez'atomi mu molekyu y'amazzi (H₂O) ne amoniya (NH₃)
2. Okuloba ebifaanaanyi bya Lewis
3. Okuzimba ebifaanaanyi bya molekyu ng'okozesa ebbumba n'obuti (physical models)
4. Okutekawo okufaanagana n'enjawulo wakati w'endabika y'omubiri ey'emolekyu zombi

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kiki ekisobola okukeberwa n'omulimu guno?

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

A. Laga bbandi z'obuziba - Ekibuuzo tekikwata ku bbandi z'obuziba
B. Kiikirira mugawanyo gwa birondoozi - Ekyo kiyinza okukwatibwamu naye si kikulu
C. Kekkereza engeri atomu gye zisaasaanyizibwamu mu molekyu nga okusinziira ku VSEPR - Kino kye kikulu! Okuzimba ebifaanaanyi by'omubiri n'okutekawo enjawulo wakati w'endabika y'emolekyu zombi kitegeeza okukebera engeri atomu gye zitegekeddwamu mu bbanga (3D geometry)
D. Londa ebikwaso n'ebitakwaso - Ekyo si kye kikulu mu mulimu guno

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kuyamba abayizi okutegeera **ebintu ebikozesebwa okumanya obunene bw'ekitundu ky'obulamu bw'akaziba ka leediyoakitiivu** (half-life).

Nnekaliriza buli kyokulabirako:

**A. Laga omuwendo ogugenda gukendeera ogw'ekintu ekiralaadiyo nga gweyoleka mu ngeri y'omugereeso.**
- Kino kikwata ku kulaga engeri omuwendo gwe gukendeera (decay) - kino kiyamba okutegeera enkola ya half-life.

**B. Teebereza ku nkola y'obuwakiso bw'obusirikale bw'ekintu ekirungo ekya leediyo.**
- Kino kikwata ku military applications - si kya bulijjo mu kuyigiriza half-life.

**C. Gattako amawulire okuva mu mmeeza y'ebipimo by'obuzito okukontana n'ebiseera ku nkyukakyuka y'ebintu eby'obusiraamu.**
- Kino kikwata ku data collection n'okukola graph - kino kiyamba abayizi okulaba engeri omuwendo gwe gukendeera n'ebiseera, ekiyamba okutegeera half-life.

**D. Gegeenya okubulukuka kw'akaziba ka leediyoaktifu era okutegeera omuwendo gw'obusirikale obubulukuse.**
- Kino kikwata ku calculations - naye tekikwata nnyo ku "ebintu ebikozesebwa okumanya."

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **ebintu ebikozesebwa okumanya** (tools/methods to determine) half-life. Ekikolwa ekisinga obulungi kwe **kukuŋŋaanya data n'okugikola mu graph** okulaba engeri omuwendo gwe gukendeera.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukebera okutegeera kw'abayizi ku **bukulu bw'ebigeranyo by'obuzito bw'ebintu ebikola ekintu** mu kikontaananyo ky'ekemyo ekikwatagana.

Ekigeranyo ky'obuzito (mass ratio) mu kemyo kikwatagana kye kigero ekiraga nti obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa (reactants) bwe bwenkanankana n'obuzito bw'ebivaamu (products) - etteeka lya **Law of Conservation of Mass**.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Balaza omuwendo gw'ekigeranyo ky'akazimbulukusa - Kino kikwata ku stoichiometry naye si ku bukulu bw'ebigeranyo by'obuzito.

**B.** Balanguula obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu era okakase omukwano oguli wakati waabyo mu kubala - Kino **kituufu** kubanga kikebera okutegeera okw'etteeka lya conservation of mass, nga balanguula obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu ne bakakasa nti bwenkanankana.

**C.** Zimba akabalansiri akalaga obwenkanankana... n'omuwendo gwabyo mu buli kikumi - Kino kikwata ku percentage composition, si ku bukulu bw'ebigeranyo by'obuzito.

**D.** Zimba akatebe akalaga omuganda oguli wakati wa mole, molekyu ne atomu - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'ebintu, si ku bukulu bw'ebigeranyo by'obuzito.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino ng'ogoberera enkola ey'emu:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omulimu oguyamba abayizi okukulaakulanya obukugu mu **kuteekateeka** nga bakola ku **mbeera z'ebintu**.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Okulaga nti obuzito tebukyuka nga kikulukusidde - kino kikwata ku **kutegeera endowooza** (concept), si kuteekateeka.

**B.** Okuwandiika n'okusiiga ekifaananyi ekiraga engeri y'okukakasa oba amazzi gakyuka obungi - kino **kyetaaga okuteekateeka** enkola y'okunoonyereza era kikwata ku **mbeera z'amazzi** (liquid state).

**C.** Okukakasa nga bakozesa ttamomiita oba ebbugumu likyuka - kino kikola ku **bubonero bw'ebbugumu**, si kuteekateeka enkola.

**D.** Kiki ekinaabaawo ku mazzi bwe ganaaba gateereddwa - kino kibuuza ku **kukyuka kw'embeera** (state change), naye si kuteekateeka enkola.

Ekibuuzo ekituufu kye **B** kubanga kyetaaga abayizi **okuteekateeka** (okuwandiika n'okusiiga) enkola y'okunoonyereza ku **mbeera z'amazzi**.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga enkola ey'okukebera obumanyirivu bw'omwana ku **kulaga oba okuyoleka ebifo by'ebitundu by'omubiri omunda** (omutima, amawuggwe, obwongo).

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Okukola eby'omu lubuto nga bakozesa ebbumba - Kino kikozesa obukugu bw'emikono naye tekikakasa bulungi obumanyirivu ku **bifo** by'ebitundu by'omubiri.

**B.** Okulonda akatundu n'okuwaayo olutalo - Kino kikebera okumanya ebitundu naye si **bifo byabyo** mu mubiri.

**C.** Okuteeka ebifaananyi by'ebitundu ku kifaananyi ky'omubiri - Kino **kikakasa ddala** oba omwana amanya **ebifo** by'ebitundu by'omubiri (omutima wali wa, obwongo buli wa, n.k.). Era okukoppa engeri gye bakozesezza ebipimo kwa omusomesa okufuna obujulizi obw'amaanyi.

**D.** Okulaba vidiyo n'okukubaganye ebirowoozo - Kino kikebera okutegeera okwa wansi naye si **bifo** by'ebitundu mu ngeri ey'amaanyi.

Ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**C**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo:

Kibuuzo kino kyebuuza ku **kyuuka kw'embeera y'ebintu** (change of state of matter) kye baana abato abasobola **okulaba nga bakozesa omuko gw'ekyuma ekimulukuta** (observe using a magnet).

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Okutabika** - Kino kiyinza okukwata ku bintu ebitabika mu mazzi, naye tekikwatagana na magnet.

**B. Okufulumuka** - Kino kwe kyuuka okuva mu bulamu obw'amazzi okudda mu mbeera y'omukka. Tekikwatagana na magnet.

**C. Okukwata** - Kino kiyinza okukwata ku bintu ebikwatibwa magnet (nga ebyuma). Abaana basobola okulaba ebintu nga clips, pins, n'ebirala nga bikwatibwa magnet - kino kye kyuuka kye basobola okulaba nga bakozesa magnet.

**D. Enfuufu** - Kino kiyinza okuba embeera y'ekintu, naye si kyuuka kye basobola okulaba bulungi nga bakozesa magnet.

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **kyuuka** (change) kye baana basobola **okulaba** nga bakozesa magnet. Okukwata (attraction/magnetization) kwe kyuuka kye basobola okulaba nga bakozesa magnet.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku musomesa mu kibiina ky'abaana abato eyigiriza "Okulowooza ng'omusaayansi" nga yeenyigidde mu **okukola ebigezo n'okuyiga ku ngeri y'okukolamu ebintu mu bwesimbu**. Obukugu obugendererwamu kwe **kulaba n'okuteebereza**.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Ekiwandiiko - kino kikwatagana n'okuwandiika, si kulaba n'okuteebereza nnyo

B. **Akakung'aanya k'ebiteeso** - kino kikwatagana nnyo n'**okukola ebigezo** (experiments), **okwetegereza ebintu** (observation), n'**okugeraageranya data** (comparing data) - bino byonna bikwatagana n'obukugu bw'okulaba n'okuteebereza mu ngeri ey'obusaayansi

C. Enkola y'enteekateeka - kino kikwatagana n'okutegeka, naye si nnyo ku kulaba n'okuteebereza

D. Ebikozesebwa - kino kyogera ku bikozesebwa, naye si nnyo ku nkola y'okuyigiriza obukugu

Ekiyanulo ekituufu kye **B** - kubanga akakung'aanya k'ebiteeso kasobozesa abaana okukola ebigezo, okwetegereza (kulaba n'okuteebereza), n'okugeraageranya ebyo bye balaba.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga kye "Okukolera awamu mu mbeera eza bulijjo, mu bikolwa ebiyamba okukulaakulanya obutonde obugunjufu."

Omusomesa yeetaaga okukebera oba abaana batuuse ku kigendererwa kino - okwetaba mu bikolwa ebiyamba obutonde.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Kola olukalala ng'okozesa akabonero okulaga ebikolwa abaana bye bakola nga tebalagiddwa mu biseera ebya bulijjo - Kino kikebera **enkolera** (action/behavior) mu mbeera za bulijjo.

**B.** Kungaanya obujulizi obw'endowooza z'abaana nga bawuliriza olugero - Kino kikebera **okutegeera** (understanding) naye si nkolera ntuufu.

**C.** Kola olukalala okukakasa oba abaana basobola okwawula ebifaananyi - Kino kikebera **okumanya/okwawula** (knowledge/discrimination) naye si nkolera ntuufu.

**D.** Kungaanya amawulire okuyita mu lukalala olw'okwekenneenya ebirowoozo - Kino kikebera **ebirowoozo** (opinions) naye si nkolera ntuufu.

Ekigendererwa kyogera ku **"okukolera awamu mu mbeera eza bulijjo"** - kino kitegeeza okukebera enkolera entuufu mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, si kumanya oba kutegeera kwokka.

**A**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kino kikwata ku musomesa ow'ekibiina ekyokusatu eyagezezza ekigendererwa "Okutegeera Eteeka lya 3R mu bikolwa ebirabika" (Okukendeeza, Okuddamu Okukozesa, Okuzza Obuggya).

## Okwekenenya Eby'okuddamu by'Omuyizi:
1. Okukozesa masiki ezinaazibwa - **Okuddamu okukozesa**
2. Okusimba ebimera mu bintu omuteekwa bbaata - **Okuzza obuggya**
3. Okwawula n'okutereeza ebintu ebigenda okusuulibwa awaka - **Okuzza obuggya**

**Ekizibu:** Omuyizi teyateeka kikolwa kyonna ku **Okukendeeza** (Reduce).

## Okwekenenya Ebyokuddamu:

**A.** Ebuuza ebibuuzo ebiyamba omuyizi okutegeera "R" eyabuzeewo (Okukendeeza) era emukulembeza okufuna ekyokulabirako ekituufu.

**B.** Esaba omuyizi okuwandiika amakulu ga buli "R" - kino tekiyamba nnyo kubanga omuyizi yalina okumanya amakulu naye yasobola okukozesa "R" emu emirundi ebiri.

**C.** Ebuuza ku ssomero n'okukubiriza bannaabwe - kino tekikwatagana nnyo n'ekizibu ekirabika.

**D.** Ebuuza ku nsonga lwaki birungi n'okukwatagana n'obucaafu - kino tekiyamba omuyizi okuzuula "R" eyabuzeewo.

## Ekyanulo Ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omulimu ogulaga engeri enjuba gy'ekusirikiramu n'okigamba banno (engeri ekisiikirize ky'enjuba bwe kyekyusakyusa).

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Bakozesa obwetoloovu obuwandiikeko obukiikirira enjuba ne basiga langi okukiikirira ekisiikirize ky'omwezi - Kino kyogera ku MWEZI si enjuba.

**B.** Bakozesa omumuli okumulisa akapiira ak'ebbala eryeru akakiikirira Ensi ne balaba ekisiikirize - Kino kisobola okulaga ekisiikirize naye tekinyonnyola bulungi engeri ekisiikirize bwe kyekyusakyusa olw'okukyukakana kw'enjuba.

**C.** Bakiikirira enjuba nga bakozesa ttaala, bamulisa ekitangaala kyayo ku lubaawo olukiikirira Ensi, era batambuuza akapiira akatono mu maaso g'ettaala ne balaba engeri enkula y'ekitundu ekimulisiddwa gyekyuka - Kino KINNYONNYOLA BULUNGI engeri ekisiikirize bwe kyekyusakyusa ng'enjuba ekyuka mu bbanga.

**D.** Bakiikirira enjuba n'etala, Ensi n'omutwe, Omwezi nga bakozesa bbulaani, era beetoloola - Kino kyogera ku nkola y'eggaali okuzungira, si ku kisiikirize ky'enjuba.

Ekiyanulo ekituufu:

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga enkola ey'okukungaanya obujulizi ku kanyonyi akalaga omutindo gw'ekitundu ekikulu: "Alaga ebitundu by'omubiri bye amanyi ng'abiraga n'engalo bw'aba abiyise."

Ekigendererwa kye kino: omwana alage ebitundu by'omubiri gye amanyi ng'abiyise.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Omuntu omukulu abuuza omwana ebitundu by'obwenyi bwe we biri - Kino kikebera okutegeera kw'omwana naye si kulaga n'engalo.

**B.** Omuntu omukulu abuuza ku nkola ez'obwongo era asaba omwana akwate ku kitundu ky'obwenyi - Kino kikwata ku nkola ez'obwongo, si kulaga ebitundu by'omubiri.

**C.** Omuntu omukulu ayimba ennyimba ezikwata ku bitundu by'obwenyi, ng'abikwatako ku mubiri gwe era ng'alaba oba omwana abiddamu - Kino kikebera oba omwana addamu, naye si kulaga n'engalo.

**D.** Omuntu omukulu akola ebintu ng'akozesa ebitundu by'omubiri gwe, oluvannyuma asaba abaana okukoppa ebikolwa ebyo - Kino kikebera okukoppa ebikolwa, naye si kulaga ebitundu by'omubiri ng'abiyise.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga enkola ey'okukebera oba omwana asobola **okulaga ebitundu by'omubiri gye amanyi ng'abiyise**. Ekyanulo **A** kye kisinga okukwatagana n'ekigendererwa kino kubanga omusomesa abuuza omwana ebitundu by'obwenyi bwe we biri, era omwana agenda kulaga n'engalo.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye "Okuteebereza ebinavaawo olw'ebintu ebibaawo mu butonde bye tulaba, nga tusinziira ku bye tumanyi n'ebyo bye tumaze okuyitamu."

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga:
1. Okuteebereza (okwogerako/okunnyonnyola) ebintu ebibaawo mu butonde
2. Okusingira ku bye bamanyi n'ebyo bye bayitamu (obumanyirivu bwabwe)

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A**: Balaba vidiyo ku mbuyaga, oluvannyuma boogera ku bye bayitamu. Kino kisinziira ku bumanyirivu bwabwe obw'obuntu.

**B**: Balaba okukoppa tsunamii, babuuzibwa kiki ekyabaddewo. Kino kikozesa okukoppa okuyigiriza.

**C**: Bazimba ekisozi ky'omuliro n'ebbumba, balaba nga kiruka (okukoppa), oluvannyuma banyonnyola kye balaba. Kino kikozesa okukoppa okuyigiriza.

**D**: Boogera ku bye bamanyi ku musisi, oluvannyuma beetegereza okukoppa omusisi, era banyonnyola ekyabaddewo. Kino kisinziira ku bumanyirivu bwabwe obw'obuntu era babuuzibwa okunnyonnyola.

Ekyokulabirako ekisinga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kye **B** kubanga:
- Balaba ekintu ekibaawo mu butonde (tsunamii)
- Babuuzibwa okuteebereza/okunnyonnyola kye balaba
- Kisinziira ku bye balaba n'okutegeera kwabwe

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku ngeri omusomesa gy'ayinza okuyamba Antonio okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa ekiri mu mutendera: "Okukuba ebigereko n'ebintu ebigattiddwa n'ebisaanuuke nga tukozesa ebintu ebikozesebwa bulijjo... nga twogera ku nkyukakyuka ezilabika."

Antonio agambye "Njagala amabala g'ossaamu" - kino kiraga nti yeeraliikirira ku langi, naye si ku nkyukakyuka ezilabika mu kugezesa.

Nnekennenya buli ky'omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola:

A. Kino kimuwa olukusa okwagala langi, naye tekimuddiza ku kiruubirirwa (nkyukakyuka ezilabika)

B. Kino kimubuulira ekyo omusomesa ky'agala, naye tekimuwa mukisa okwekenneenya yekka

C. Kino kimubuuza okulab'enjawulo wakati w'ebirangi mu mafuta n'ebyo mu mazzi - kino kimuddiza ku nkyukakyuka ezilabika era kimusaba okukenneenya n'okulaba enjawulo

D. Kino kimulagira ky'alina okulaba, naye tekimuwa mukisa okwekenneenya yekka

Ekiyanulo ekituufu kye **C** - kubanga kimubuuza okulab'enjawulo (nkyukakyuka ezilabika) era kimusindiikiriza okukenneenya yekka.

**C**

Ekibuuzo kino kyogera ku cytoskeleton (omubiri gw'obutoffaali) n'omulimu gwagwo.

Cytoskeleton ye nkola y'ennyingo ezikola ng'omusingi mu butoffaali. Eguwa obutoffaali enkula yaabwo, eyamba mu ntambula y'ebintu munda mu butoffaali, era ekuuma obutegeka bw'ebitundu by'obutoffaali.

Bwe tugeraageranya n'ekkolero:
- A: Ekikyusa ebintu ebiramu okubifuula amaanyi - kino kyogera ku mitochondria
- B: Enkola etegeka ebintu mu ngeri esobozesa ebintu okutereera - kino kyogera ku nkola z'okutambuza (transport systems)
- C: Ekifo ekikulu ekikulukusa amawulire - kino kyogera ku nucleus
- D: Ekissa akabonero ku bintu ebiggyibwa - kino kyogera ku Golgi apparatus

Cytoskeleton ekola ng'omusingi/ennyingo (structural framework) mu kkolero - efaanana ng'emisingi egy'ekizimbe oba ennyingo ezikuuma ekkolero mu nkola yaayo era eziyamba ebintu okutambula.

Mu byokulonda ebiweereddwa, **B** ye esinga okukwatagana ne cytoskeleton kubanga eyogera ku nkola etegeka ebintu era eyamba mu kutambuza ebintu munda mu kkolero.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku musomesa ayagala okuyamba abayizi okutegeera **omulamwa gw'ekikululo** (osmosis).

Ekikululo kye ntambula y'amazzi okuyita mu kabindi akalonda (semi-permeable membrane) okuva mu kifo omuli obuwunga obutono okugenda mu kifo omuli obuwunga obungi.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Kino kigera obuzito bw'akatundulu mu mazzi isotonic - tekikwata nnyo ku kikululo.

**B.** Kino kigera ku buwumbo mu mazzi ag'ebbugumu ery'enjawulo - kino kikwata ku bwangu bw'okusaasaana, si kikululo.

**C.** Kino kigera ku buwunga bw'ekyenvu okusaasaana mu mazzi - kino kigera ku kusaasaana (diffusion), si kikululo.

**D.** Kino kiraga olubaawo olulina ebisenge bibiri nga byawuddwaamu **akabindi akalekera obutoffaali obutono okuyita** (semi-permeable membrane). Amazzi gava mu kisenge omuli obutoffaali obutono ne gagenda mu kisenge omuli obutoffaali obungi - kino kye kikululo ddala!

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi bakwataganye enkulaakulana ennene ey'enkola y'ebinyira munda mu butoffaali n'omulimu gwayo.

Nneebera buli kyokulabirako:

A. Teeka ebifaananyi by'obutoffaali obuzimba ebintu era bamanya omulimu gwa buli kanyama - Kino kiyigiriza ku mimu gy'obutoffaali naye tekikwata ku **nkola y'ebinyira munda** n'enkulaakulana yaayo.

B. Basabe okusiiga ekkubo ly'ebipooli okuyita mu nkola y'okufulumya ebintu - Kino kikwata ku **nkola y'ebinyira munda** (okufulumya ebintu) n'enkulaakulana yaayo (ekkubo ly'ebipooli).

C. Geraageranya emirimu gy'akataffaali akakola obutindo n'ak'emisajja - Kino kikwata ku mimu gy'enjawulo, si nkola y'ebinyira munda.

D. Manya omulimu gw'obutonniinya okusinziira ku ndabika - Kino kikwata ku ndabika n'omulimu, naye si ku nkola y'ebinyira munda n'enkulaakulana yaayo.

Ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi abuuza: "Butaffaali bwa pulokyaati busobola butya okweyabuluzaamu?"

Ekibuuzo kino kyetaaga okunnyonnyola engeri obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic bwe bweyabuluzaamu.

Nneekebera buli kiyanulo:

A. Kyogera ku kuzaala okutali kya kikaba, naye tekinyonnyola bulungi engeri y'okweyabuluza

B. Kyogera ku DNA wokka, naye tekiwa nnyonnyola entuufu ey'enkola y'okweyabuluza

C. Kyogera ku "okutomeguka" (cell division) mu ngeri enterevu, naye tekiwa bunyonyi bungi

D. Kino kinnyonnyola bulungi nti obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic bukozesa "binary fission" - DNA ekoppebwa, oluvannyuma ekikulukusi ky'obutaffaali ne kyeyawulamu ne kivaamu obutaffaali bubiri obwenkanankana. Kino kye kinnyonnyola ekituufu era eky'obunyonyi ku ngeri obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic bwe bweyabuluzaamu.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekigendererwa: "Okunnyonnyola emisingi gy'ennyingo ya Dalton ku atomu."

Ennyingo ya Dalton ku atomu erimu emisingi gino:
- Ebintu byonna bikola atomu ezitayawukana
- Atomu z'ekintu kimu zifaanagana mu bunene n'obuzito
- Atomu z'ebintu eby'enjawulo zirina obuzito n'obunene obutali bumu
- Mu bikolwa by'ekemiko, atomu ziyunga mu migero egy'enkalubo (ratios) egitegeerekeka

Nnekennenya buli kiragiro:

A. Bikola ebintu eby'ekimiyiki eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku kulonda eby'obuziba bibiri oba okusingawo.
- Kino kikwata ku nnyingo ya Dalton nti ebintu bikola atomu ez'obuziba obutali bumu eziyunga mu migero egy'enkalubo.

B. Zimuteekawo omuwendo gw'obungi bw'obuziba obwetabye mu kikolwa eky'ekemiko.
- Kino kikwata ku migero egy'enkalubo mu bikolwa by'ekemiko.

C. Zigikwataganya obuzito bw'ebintu ebiri mu kintu ekigatte n'obuzito bw'ekintu ekigatte kyonna.
- Kino kikwata ku tteeka ly'okukuuma obuzito, si nnyingo ya Dalton.

D. Bakakasa obuzito bw'ekintu ekiri mu bizimbamubiri bisatu eby'enkalubo y'emu.
- Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka z'ebintu, si nnyingo ya Dalton.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukakasa oba abayizi **bategeera omulimu gw'ebiramu ebireetawo emmere** (producer organisms).

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Kituukirize ekifaananyi ky'ekirimwa...** - Kino kiragisa obukugu bw'okukola ekifaananyi, naye tekikakasa bulungi oba omuyizi ategeera ddala omulimu gw'ebiramu ebikola emmere.

**B. Wa ebyokulabirako by'ebiramu ebikola emmere** - Kino kiragisa oba omuyizi asobola okuzuula/okumanya ebiramu ebikola emmere, naye tekikakasa oba ategeera **omulimu gwabyo**.

**C. Singa ebimera bibulawo, kiki ekiyinza okubaawo...** - Kino kiragisa **okutegeera omulimu** gw'ebiramu ebikola emmere mu mutimbagiro gw'emmere. Omuyizi alina okutegeera nti ebimera bikola emmere okuva ku musana, era singa bibulawo, ebiramu ebirala tebiyinza kufuna mmere - kino kiragisa okutegeera omulimu gwabyo obukulu.

**D. Teekawo enkolagana wakati w'ebiramu...** - Kino kikwata ku mutimbagiro gwonna, si ku mulimu gw'ebiramu ebikola emmere gwokka.

Ekibuuzo ekituufu kye **C** kubanga kiragisa okutegeera omulimu n'obukulu bw'ebiramu ebikola emmere mu mutimbagiro gw'emmere.

**C**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kino kyogera ku **nkola y'okubaga ebirowoozo** (hypothesis formation) mu kunoonyereza kwa ssaayansi.

Nkola y'okubaga ebirowoozo etegeeza:
- Okuteekawo endowooza ey'okugezesa eyeesigamiziddwa ku bibuuzo
- Endowooza eno esobola okugezesebwa
- Erina okuba n'ensonga ezigitegeeza

Ka tulabe buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Kino kyogera ku **kuddamu** okusinziira ku bivuddemu - kino kijja oluvannyuma lw'okugezesa, si kuteekawo endowooza

**B.** Kino kyogera ku **kuteekawo enteekateeka y'okugezesa** - kino nakyo kijja oluvannyuma lw'okubaga endowooza

**C.** Kino **kibuuzo** kyokka, si ndowooza ey'okugezesa

**D.** Kino kiwa **ekibuuzo ekikulu** ("Omugatte gwa CO2 gwe gukosa gutya obungi bw'emmere ebimera gye bikola?") era abayizi **balonda ku ndowooza ez'enjawulo** - kino kye kituufu ddala kubanga okubaga ebirowoozo kwe kuteekawo ebirowoozo eby'enjawulo ebisobola okuddamu ekibuuzo, oluvannyuma n'olonda erisingako okuba ennungi okugezesa.

**D**

# Okwekenenya Ekibuuzo

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi okutegeera nti ebika by'ebiramu ebiri mu nkolagana ey'okuva mu bintu bye bimu gye byava gye biri kumpi mu byafaayo.

Ekizibu: Abayizi abamu tebannategeera nsonga eno.

Nneekebera buli kyokulabirako:

**A. Londa ebimera okusinziira ku ngeri gye bifaanana mu ndabika.**
- Kino kiyamba abayizi okulaba obufaananafu mu ndabika, naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'enkolagana ey'okuva mu bintu bye bimu.

**B. Ddamu ebibuuzo nga osinziira ku kunoonyereza okukoleddwa ku kladogramu.**
- Kladogramu ye dayagula eraga enkolagana y'ebiramu n'engeri gye byava mu bintu bye bimu. Kino kituufu ddala ku kigendererwa.

**C. Lambaala dayagula eraga ebyokulabirako by'ebisigalira ebitereevu n'ebitali bitereevu.**
- Kino kikwatagana n'enkyukakyuka naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'enkolagana y'okuva mu bintu bye bimu.

**D. Gerageranya ebimyuuka by'ebitundu by'omubiri ebitali bikola nnyo mu biramu eby'enjawulo okukakasa enkolagana yaabyo.**
- Kino kiyamba okulaga enkolagana naye kiyinza okuba kizibu nnyo eri abayizi ab'omu mwaka ogusooka.

Ekyanulo ekisinga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kya **B** kubanga kladogramu ye dayagula enkulu mu kuyigiriza enkolagana y'ebiramu n'engeri gye byava mu bintu bye bimu.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omusomesa okuyamba abayizi:
1. Okutegeera omugaso gw'okugemesa okw'ekikolimo
2. Okutambulira wamu n'endagaano y'ebiri mu syllabus ekwata ku kumanya okw'ekisaayansi

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Kunnyonnyola ebyafaayo bya Edward Jenner - Kino kiyigiriza ebyafaayo byokka, naye tekiyamba nnyo mu kutegeera omugaso gwa kati gw'okugemesa.

B. Okunoonyereza obungi bw'endwadde ezimu - Kino kiyamba okutegeera embeera y'endwadde naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'okugemesa.

C. Okugeraageranya omuwendo gw'abantu abaagemeebwa n'okusaanyizibwawo/okuddamu okubalukawo kw'endwadde - Kino kiragisa bulungi omugaso gw'okugemesa nga kiraga enkwatagana wakati w'okugema n'okukendeeza ku ndwadde. Era kikozesa data (chati) ekiyamba mu kumanya okw'ekisaayansi.

D. Okuzimba olukalala lw'ebikulu - Kino kiyigiriza ebyafaayo byokka.

Ekikolwa ekisinga okutuukiriza ebigendererwa byombi kye:

**C**

Nneekebeza ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi agamba nti "ekitundu ekipya kiyimirira mu busa bw'eggi ekiyitibwa corpus luteum" - kino kiragisa nti corpus luteum kitandikirawo nga kitundu ekipya, naye mu nkola entuufu, corpus luteum kava mu follicle (akalobo) eyasooka okuba n'eggi. Si kitundu ekipya ekiyimirira, wabula kye kitundu kye kimu (follicle) ekikyuka ne kifuuka corpus luteum oluvannyuma lw'okuva kw'eggi.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza buzibu ki mu kutuukiriza ekigendererwa - ekigendererwa kye kutegeera omutendera gw'ebisa eggi n'omutendera gw'ennyingo y'omubuto.

Ekyokulondamu D kiragisa nti omuyizi tadde mu ndowooza nti corpus luteum katandikirawo kokka, naye mu nkola entuufu kava mu follicle eyasooka okubaawo.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: "Okutegeera omukwano wakati w'entekateeka y'okukola eby'emmere kw'ebimera n'ey'okussa kw'obutaffaali bw'ebiramu"

Ebisaanidde okukakasibwa:
1. Omukwano/enkolagana wakati w'enkola zombi
2. Engeri gye zikolagana mu butonde
3. Obusobozi bw'omuyizi okutegeera enkolagana eno

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A**: Komawoyo ekyaati - Kino kisobola okulaga enjawulo naye tekikakasa okutegeera kw'omuyizi ku mukwano/enkolagana

**B**: Ennyonnyola ennene - Eno ennyonnyola bulungi omukwano: okutangaaza kw'ebimera kufulumya okisijeni (ogukozesebwa mu kussa), okussa kufulumya kaboni dayokisaidi (ekozesebwa mu kutangaaza). Eno y'ennyonnyola ennuŋŋamu ey'enkolagana.

**C**: Omubalanguzo gw'ebikemiko - Guno mulungi naye gwa ssaayansi ennyo eri ekibiina ekisooka, era tekakasa okutegeera kw'omuyizi

**D**: Lambaala akabonero - Kino kisobola okulaga ebintu naye tekikakasa obusobozi bw'omuyizi okutegeera omukwano

Ekyanulo ekisinga obulungi okukakasa obutuukirivu bw'ekigendererwa kye:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku Fludarabine, eddagala eriziyiza DNA primase. DNA primase ye enzayimu ekola pulayima za RNA (RNA primers) ezeetaagisa mu kutandikira okukoppololwa kwa DNA.

Bwe kibuuza nti "ddamu ki mu kukoppololwa kwa DNA Fludarabine ly'ekosa butereevu?", kitegeeza nti abayizi balina okutegeera omulimu gwa DNA primase.

DNA primase ekola pulayima za RNA ezeetaagisa okutandikira okukoppololwa kwa DNA. Bwe eziyizibwa, okukoppololwa kwa DNA tekusobola kutandika.

Noolwekyo ekibuuzo kipima okutegeera **omulimu gwa enzayimu ekola pulayima za RNA**.

**A**

Nsomooza ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi okukola ebifaananyi ebinnyonnyola eby'obwengula ebiri mu nkola y'enjuba, nga yeesigama ku bunene bw'enjuba n'ebipooli. Alina akatebe k'ebibalanguzi omuli omugatte gw'enjuba n'ebipooli ng'akozesa ennyingo y'ekibalangulo.

Nkola ki eyandibadde esinga okusaana okwongerwako?

**A.** Tegeka ebirimu mu ggulu okuva ku kitono okudda ku kinene - kino kikwata ku ntereeza naye si ku bunene bwabyo obwa mazima.

**B.** Teeka ekibalanguza ky'ensi nga akakodyo akakozesebwa era okole akakolumu akabalirira omuwendo oguli wakati w'ekibalanguza ky'ebitundu by'omu bwengula eby'enjawulo n'ekyo ky'ensi - kino kiyamba abayizi okulaba obwangu bw'ebitundu by'omu bwengula okuva ku nsi, era kiyamba okutegeera obunene bw'enjuba mu ngeri ey'okugeraageranya.

**C.** Ebibuuzo ebya Yee/Nedda - bino bisoomooza okutegeera okwa bulijjo naye si mu ngeri ey'okwegezaamu oba ey'okukola ebifaananyi ebinnyonnyola.

**D.** Omulongoosa gw'okwegezaamu ku nnukuta za sayansi - kino kiyamba okutegeera obunene bw'enjuba mu ngeri ey'enamba, era kiyamba abayizi okukola embalirira n'okugeraageranya obunene bw'ebitundu by'omu bwengula mu ngeri ey'ekikugu.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga "ebifaananyi ebinnyonnyola" - ekyanulo **D** kiwa abayizi omukisa okukola embalirira n'okugeraageranya obunene bw'enjuba n'ebipooli mu ngeri ey'enamba, era kino kiyamba okukola ebifaananyi ebinnyonnyola eby'obunene bwabyo.

**D**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino. Ka nnoonyereze mu ngeri ennuŋŋamu:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omulimu ogukwataganya ebirimu by'essomo ku Kinematics n'engeri y'ekibalangulo ky'obutonde bw'ensi nga bwe kiri mu ssomero.

Nneekenneenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A. Bannyonnyola engeri omulamwa gw'okwanguya okukwatagana n'ensi bwe gukozesebwa okugonjoola ebizibu ebya bulijjo**
- Kino kikwataganya tekinologiya (omulamwa) n'okukozesa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo
- Kino kikwataganya ssaayansi n'ensi ey'okutuukirira

**B. Banannyonnyola engeri endowooza y'okwanguya okusikirizibwa kw'ensi gy'ekulakulanye mu byafaayo by'omuntu**
- Kino kikwata ku byafaayo, si nnyo ku kwataganya n'ensi ey'okutuukirira

**C. Bannyonnyola engeri enkulaakulana mu tekinologiya gy'ezzeeko okukkiriza okutuukiriza obutuufu obusingako mu kupima omuwendo gw'amaanyi agasikayo ebintu**
- Kino kikwata ku byafaayo by'ebyobufuzi, si nnyo ku kwataganya n'ensi ey'okutuukirira

**D. Banannyonnyola engeri omubiri gwe gugwamu nga teguumirizibwa kintu kyonna n'engeri okugwa kuno gye kwesigamye ku bwangu bw'amasoboza agasikayo ebintu**
- Kino kikwata ku nkola ya ssaayansi yokka, si nnyo ku kwataganya n'ensi ey'okutuukirira

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kugerageranya "omugera gw'amazzi" okwongera okutegeera ebikwata ku masannyalaze agolokofu. Kitubuuza lwaki engeri eno ey'okugerageranya efuuka **ekizibu** ng'enkola y'okuyigiriza.

Nnekennenya buli kyokuloonda:

**A.** Tekikola nga kyakuyiga ku misituluzi egy'omugereko oba egy'ekigere.
- Kino tekikwatagana nnyo n'ekibuuzo.

**B.** Kizzaamu abayizi amaanyi okukkiriza nti amasannyalaze "gasobola okukka" mu waya, naye "tegasobola kwambuka".
- Kino kya mazima. Mu mazzi, amazzi gasobola okukka mu payipu era ne gasobola okuvaamu. Naye amasannyalaze si kintu ekikka mu waya - ge mpewo z'amasannyalaze ezitambula. Okugerageranya n'amazzi kiyinza okuleeta okutegeera okw'obukyamu.

**C.** Tekikkiriza bayizi kukwataganya mulamwa gw'obusitoowa mu sseketi y'amasannyalaze n'ekintu kyonna ekilabika mu sseketi y'amazzi.
- Kino nakyo kya mazima. Obusitoowa mu sseketi y'amasannyalaze tekufaanana na kintu kyonna mu sseketi y'amazzi.

**D.** Kikubiriza abayizi okulowooza nti omugendo gw'amasannyalaze mu ssaawa y'amasannyalaze gulinga omugendo gw'amazzi mu ssaawa y'amazzi.
- Kino nakyo kiyinza okuba ekizibu.

Ekizibu ekisinga obukulu mu kugerageranya kuno kwe kuleeta endowooza enkyamu nti amasannyalaze "gakka" mu waya nga amazzi bwe gakka mu payipu.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi atasobola kutegeera njawulo wakati w'ebifaananyi ebituufu n'ebifaananyi ebyekiise (ebya nnamaddala/obulimba), era alina okumanyisibwa ensonga lwaki biyitibwa bityo.

Nnekalakasa buli kiyanulo:

- Kino kikulu nnyo okumanya nga tonnasomesebwa ku mitindo gy'obwerinde. Oteekwa okutegeera kye kizibiti (pathogen) n'engeri gye kyawukana n'akawuka (antibody) akakiziyiza.

**B. Enjawulo wakati w'emirimu gy'obutaffaali bwa B ne T**
- Kino kya mangu nnyo era kya technical. Kino kiyinza okusomesebwa wamu n'omutindo ogw'okusatu.

**C. Okukkiriza n'okujjukira kw'omubiri**
- Kino kye kikulu okutegeera omutindo ogw'okusatu, naye kino kiyinza okusomesebwa wamu n'omutindo.

**D. Okutolokwa okw'amaanyi n'obutonde bw'omubiri**
- Kino kya general nnyo.

Ekibuuzo ekisinga okuba eky'awali era ekikulu okutegeera omutindo ogw'okusatu kwe **kutegeera enjawulo wakati w'ekizibiti (ekirwaza) n'akawuka (akakiziyiza)**.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku etteeka lya Hooke, erikwata ku maanyi g'omutunziro. Etteeka lya Hooke linnyonnyola nti amaanyi ageetaagisa okugololola oba okusindika omutunziro gakwatagana butereevu n'obuwanvu omutunziro gwe gugololeddwa (F = -kx).

Okutegeera etteeka lino, omuyizi alina okuba nga amaze okuyiga:

**A. Okikiikirira obunene, obwolekero, n'engeri y'amaanyi gye gakolamu** - Kino kikulu nnyo kubanga etteeka lya Hooke lyogera ku maanyi (obunene bwago n'obwolekero), n'engeri amaanyi gye gakola ku mutunziro.

**B. Omukwano wakati w'amaanyi g'obuzito n'enkyukakyuka omubiri gye guba nagyo** - Kino si kya nkizo nnyo ku tteeka lya Hooke.

**C. Enjawulo y'amaanyi ag'enkanankana oba agaddawo** - Kino si kya nkizo nnyo ku tteeka lya Hooke.

**D. Okutegeera engeri amaanyi gye gakosaamu enkula n'entambula** - Kino si kya nkizo nnyo ku tteeka lya Hooke.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okulaba ekiraga nti ekiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga kituukiddwako: "Okunnyonnyola engeri ggaasi ennungi gye zeeyisaamu mu mbeera eza bulijjo, nga otunuulira amateeka agigoberera."

Ebikulu mu kiruubirirwa kino:
- Okunnyonnyola engeri ggaasi ennungi gye zeeyisaamu
- Mu mbeera eza bulijjo
- Nga otunuulira amateeka agigoberera

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

A. Bakozesa amateeka ga Boyle, Gay-Lussac, ne Charles mu ngeri etali ya kubala - Kino kikyusa ku kukozesa amateeka naye tekikakasa nti bannyonnyola engeri ggaasi gye zeeyisaamu mu mbeera eza bulijjo.

B. Bannyonnyola ebifa mu ggulaafu - Kino kikwata ku ggulaafu, si ku kunnyonnyola engeri ggaasi gye zeeyisaamu mu mbeera eza bulijjo.

C. Balaga mu bulamu obwa bulijjo obungi bw'ebipimo by'ebintu eby'omukka omungi n'ebipimo by'obugumu bwabyo - Kino kikwata ku "bulamu obwa bulijjo" era ku "kunnyonnyola" (balaga) engeri ggaasi gye zeeyisaamu.

D. Bakubalira omuwendo - Kino kikwata ku kubala, naye ekiruubirirwa kyetaaga "okunnyonnyola" si kubala.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukakasa obutuukirivu bw'akabonero kano: "Okwaawula ebintu ebiyisa amasannyalaze okuva ku bitabiyisa"

Kino kitegeeza abayizi balina okumanya ebintu ki ebiyisa amasannyalaze (ebikwatibwa amasannyalaze) n'ebitayisa amasannyalaze (ebitakwatibwa amasannyalaze).

Nnekennenya buli kikolwa:

A. Kwetegereza ekikolwa ky'amasannyalaze ekikola n'ogutakola - kino kiyamba okutegeera engeri amasannyalaze gye gakola naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'okwaawula ebintu.

B. Kwetegereza akataambi k'amasannyalaze agatambulira mu byuma ebitali bimu - kino kikwatagana n'okutambula kw'amasannyalaze mu byuma, si kwaawula ebintu ebiyisa n'ebitayisa.

C. Lwaki omusajja alina okwambala engalo za laaba - kino kikwatagana n'obukuumi, si kwaawula ebintu.

D. Laga ekifaananyi ky'akazinga k'amasannyalaze era obasabe okulonda mu bintu (foorka ey'ekyuma, kamuyooyo ow'omu polasitika, akakaba ak'omu labba) ekiyinza okuggusa akazinga - **Kino kikwatagana butereevu n'okwaawula ebintu ebiyisa amasannyalaze (ekyuma) okuva ku bitabiyisa (polasitika, labba).**

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omuyizi okulaga nti atuukidde ku kabonero ka: "Okutawula ebipimo ebikozesebwa okunnyonnyola ekikankano ky'ettaka"

Kino kitegeeza omuyizi alina okutegeera n'okukozesa obulungi ebipimo (nga ekipimo kya Richter) ebikozesebwa okupima amaanyi g'emisisi.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Kulonda ensindikiriro y'omusisi - Kino kikwata ku nsibuko y'omusisi, si ku bipimo ebikozesebwa okugupima.

B. Okunoonyereza ku musisi eyasinga obunene - Kino kikwata ku byafaayo, si ku kutegeera n'okukozesa ebipimo.

C. Okulonda ensobi mu nkozesa y'ebigambo - Kino kikwata ku bigambo, si ku bipimo.

D. Enjawulo wakati w'obubonero bubiri ku kipimo kya Richter mu buwero bw'amaanyi - Kino KIKWATA DDALA ku kutegeera n'okukozesa ekipimo (Richter scale) okutawula amaanyi g'emisisi.

**D**

Nneekebeza ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi abuuza lwaki bageraageranya amino asidi za puloteni nga DNA y'erimu amawulire. Omusomesa alina okuddamu ng'annyonnyola engeri amino asidi sequences gye zikwatagana ne DNA n'engeri gye zisobola okukozesebwa okuteebereza enkolagana z'ebika.

Nneekebera buli ddamu:

**A**: Egamba nti ekizimbamubiri kye kimu kisobola okubaawo mu bika eby'enjawulo, era nti okumanya enjawulo mu genes n'amino acid sequences kiyamba okuteebereza enkolagana. Kino kituufu naye tekinyonnyola bulungi enkwatagana wakati wa DNA n'amino asidi.

**B**: Ennyonnyola bulungi nti puloteni zikolebwa mu amino asidi ekkodeddwa mu DNA, era nti enkyukakyuka mu DNA zikyusa amino acid sequence. Kino kinnyonnyola obulungi enkwatagana wakati wa DNA (amawulire) n'amino asidi (ekiva), era kinnyonnyola lwaki okugeraageranya amino asidi kuyamba okumanya enkolagana z'ebika.

**C**: Egamba ku RNA n'okuwandiika, naye tekinyonnyola bulungi enkwatagana wakati wa DNA n'amino asidi mu ngeri ey'amanyi.

**D**: Egamba ku codons n'enkola y'okuvvuunuka, naye kino kya technical nnyo era tekiddamu kibuuzo ky'omuyizi mu ngeri ennyangu.

Ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi kyali: "mugaso ki ogw'okugeraageranya amino asidi nga DNA y'erimu amawulire?" Ekiddamu **B** kinnyonnyola bulungi enkwatagana eno.

**B**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino ekikwata ku ssaayansi y'obuzaale n'okukyusa obuziizi.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza lwaki eggi (egg cell/oocyte) lyokka ly'ekozesebwa mu magezi ga John Gurdon ag'okukyusa obuziizi, so si butaffaali bulala obwawuddwamu obuziizi.

Nneekenneenya buli kiyanulo:

**A**: Kino kyannyonnyola nti akataffaali kalina okuba nga tekannakyuka, naye tekinyonnyola lwaki eggi lyennyini ly'ekozesebwa.

**B**: Kino kinnyonnyola bulungi nti oocyte (eggi) lirina cytoplasm erimu ebintu ebyenjawulo ebiyamba okwawula ebika by'obutaffaali nga bisunsula ebikolwa by'okuwandiika n'okuvvuunula ebiri mu buziizi obuteereddwamu. Kino kwe kunyonnyola okuntuufu lwaki eggi lyennyini ly'ekozesebwa - kubanga cytoplasm yaalyo erina ebintu ebyenjawulo ebiyamba obuziizi obuteereddwamu okuzuukuka n'okuddamu okutandika enkyukakyuka y'okukula.

**C**: Kino kigamba nti obutaffaali obulala tebusobola, naye tekinyonnyola bulungi lwaki.

**D**: Kino kyannyonnyola nti eggi lirina ebintu byonna ebyetaagisa, naye ennyonnyola si ntuufu nnyo era si ya mazima.

Ekiyanulo ekituufu kye:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi abuuza nti bwe basanga omuntu alina **IgG naye talina IgM** (IgG positive, IgM negative), kitegeeza ki?

Nnelowooza ku makulu g'antibodies zino:
- **IgM**: Antibody esooka okujja mu musaayi ng'omuntu akasirikiddwa (acute/early infection)
- **IgG**: Antibody ejja oluvannyuma, esigala mu musaayi okumala ebbanga ddene (past infection/recovery)

Bwe basanga **IgG wekka nga IgM teri**, kitegeeza:
- Omuntu yali alina akawuka edda
- Awonye
- IgM emaze okuggwaako (kubanga ejja mu kusooka naye tebeera mu musaayi buwanvu)
- IgG esigalawo ng'obujulizi bw'okuba yali alina akawuka n'awona

Nnelowooza ku byanukulo:

A. Tegituufu - tabuulira bulungi ku IgG ne IgM
B. Tegituufu - kino kitegeeza ekiseera ekibaawo amangu (acute phase) naye IgM ye eba eri mu kiseera kino
C. Tegituufu - kino nakyo kitegeeza ekiseera ekisooka, naye IgM ye eba eri mu kiseera kino
D. **Kituufu** - Kinnyonnyola bulungi nti omuntu awonye, IgM esooka okujja, oluvannyuma IgG, ate IgG esigala mu musaayi okumala ebbanga ddene

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi bategeere "engeri ebizimba bya kansa gye bikolebwa" (how cancer cells are formed).

Kansa iva ku nkyukakyuka (mutations) mu DNA ezireeta okugabanyizibwa kw'akataffaali okutali kwa bulijjo - akataffaali kagabanyizibwa awatali kuteekebwa mu nteekateeka era katayimirira nga bwe kalina okuba.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Ebiseera by'omutendera gw'obulamu bw'akataffaali - Kino kikulu naye si kya musingi nnyo mu kutegeera kansa

B. Obukulu bw'ekigabanyo ky'obutaffaali ekya mitosis - Kino KYA MUSINGI! Kansa kiva ku mitosis etali ya bulijjo/etateekebwako. Abayizi balina okutegeera mitosis eya bulijjo bwe kola okusobola okutegeera engeri gye kyonooneka mu kansa.

C. Ebifo omukutu gwe kikula ky'obutaffaali mwe guyita - Kino si kya musingi mu kutegeera enkola ya kansa

D. Ebika by'enkyukakyuka mu DNA ne mu chromosome - Kino nakyo kikulu naye mitosis y'enkola enkulu eyonooneka

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kunnyonnyola engeri omukutu gw'obubonero bw'obusimu gye gukwataganyaamu ebikolwa by'ekiramu okusobola okwetoloola embeera ng'okuyita mu bubonero obuweerezebwa obutaffaali bw'obusimu okwetoloola omubiri gwonna.

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga:
- Okunnyonnyola engeri omukutu gw'obubonero gye gukwataganyaamu
- Okwetoloola embeera
- Okuyita mu bubonero obuweerezebwa obutaffaali bw'obusimu
- Okwetoloola omubiri gwonna

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

A. Bakebera ebifaananyi... ne basobola okwawula ebitundu byabyo - Kino kikwata ku kwawula ebitundu, naye si kunnyonnyola engeri omukutu gye gukwataganyaamu.

B. Bannyonnyola enkyukakyuka... okusinziira ku maanyi agukubye - Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka, naye si ku nkwataganya y'omukutu gwonna.

C. Bannyonnyola engeri ebizimba by'obutoffaali bw'obwongo gye bikolebwamu - Kino kyetunuulira ku bizimba by'obwongo, naye si ku mukutu gwonna.

D. Banannyonnyola omukulu gw'omugongo, obwongo, ebintu ebiwulira, n'ebikola mu nteekateeka y'okuddamu kw'obubonero bw'obwongo - Kino kinnyonnyola ebitundu byonna eby'omukutu (omugongo, obwongo, ebiwulira, ebikola) n'engeri gye bikwataganyaamu mu nteekateeka y'okuddamu.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekigendererwa: "Okukozesa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu nkola enzigale"

Etteeka lino liyigiriza nti mu nkola enzigale (closed system), omugatte gw'amaanyi gusigala nga gwe gwe gumu nga tewali maanyi agayingira oba agafuluma.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Obutomere - kino kikwata ku butonde bw'ebintu, si ku maanyi.

B. Okupima obuzito bw'emmotoka ne mbiro - kino kikwata ku mass/obuzito, ate etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka likwata ku maanyi (energy), si mass. Wadde mass ne energy bikwatagana, kino si kyokulabirako kituufu eky'etteeka ly'amaanyi.

C. Omukwano wakati w'amaanyi agakozeseddwa, obudde, n'empalirizo - kino kikwata ku work-energy theorem (omulimu = amaanyi × olubatu), era kiraga engeri amaanyi gye gakyusibwa okuva mu ngeri emu okudda mu ndala mu nkola enzigale.

D. Okugong'ana wakati w'ebibiina - kino kisobola okulaga etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu kugong'ana (elastic collision), nga omugatte gw'amaanyi gusigala nga gwe gwe gumu nga tewannagong'ana ne nga wamaze okugong'ana.

Ekyokulabirako ekisinga okulaga obulungi etteeka lino kiri mu:

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: "Okukozesa omutindo gw'amayengo okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka era ne kimenyeka bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri."

Ebikulu mu kigendererwa:
- Okukozesa omutindo gw'amayengo (hands-on/practical)
- Okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka (reflects)
- Era ne kimenyeka (refracts)
- Bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri (interface between two materials)

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Ekitundu ky'ekitabo - Kino kikozesa kusoma, si "omutindo gw'amayengo"

B. Okutengejja okw'ekikompyuta - Kino kikozesa teknologiya naye si "omutindo gw'amayengo" nga abaana bakikola bennyini

C. Okulaga mu kibiina omutangaavu gwa leza - Kino kya "hands-on demonstration" era kilaga byombi: okuddamu kw'ekitangaala (reflection) n'okumenyeka (refraction) nga omutangaavu gukuba amazzi

D. Omulimu ogukolebwa ku kompyuta - Kino simulation, si "omutindo gw'amayengo" mu ngeri entuufu

Ekiyanulo ekituufu:

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa annyonnyola ku maanyi agasikayo ebintu byonna (gravity) era alaga oluyimba lw'ekkompyuta olulaga appo ng'egwa okuva ku muti oba omwezi nga gwekulungulula Ensi. Abayizi abamu tebasobola kukwataganya mbeera zino n'etteeka.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Omusomesa ayinza kukozesa ki okwongera okutegeera kw'abayizi n'okutangaza okutabuka kwabwe?

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Akozesa omugwa n'akapiira okwoleka amaanyi agasindikiriza ekintu wakati (centripetal force) - Kino kikwata ku maanyi agasindikiriza wakati, si gravity ennyo.

**B.** Enyonyoza ekiraga ekintu ekipima obuzito kinene ekikiikirira Ensi, ne kireetera ebintu ebitono okugwa oba okwetoloola - Kino kinyonnyola bulungi gravity n'engeri gye kikola ku bintu eby'enjawulo (appo n'omwezi).

**C.** Akozesa ekijjulo ky'emmwanyi n'akapiira okwoleka engeri embiro gye zikosa ku ntambula - Kino kikwata ku maanyi n'embiro, naye si nnyonnyola nnungi ya gravity.

**D.** Akolera akabonero ku lubaawo akalaga obuzito bw'apple n'obw'Ensi, n'oluvannyuma alongoosa okulaga engeri omwezi n'Ensi gye bikwatagana - Kino kinyonnyola bulungi gravity mu mbeera zombi (appo n'omwezi) nga kikozesa akabonero akakwataganya n'ebyo abayizi bye balabye ku kompyuta.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okusomesa ebirowoozo bingi ebikwata ku mayengo n'amaloboozi. Ekibuuzo kyebuuza birowoozo ki **BIBIRI** by'alina **OKUSOOKA** okukolako nga birowoozo by'omusingi okusobola okutegeera ebirala.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Omuyaga n'amasoboza** - Bino si birowoozo by'omusingi nnyo mu kuyiga amayengo

**B. Omugatte gw'emirundi (Frequency) n'obuwanvu bw'amayengo (Wavelength)** - Bino bye birowoozo by'omusingi ebikulu ennyo mu kuyiga amayengo. Frequency ne wavelength bye bipimo ebikulu eby'omusingi ebinnyonnyola amayengo gonna. Ebirowoozo ebirala byonna nga pitch, intensity, speed, period bisobola okutegeezebwa oba bikolagana n'ebyo bibiri.

**C. Okunkunuka n'omuwendo gw'okukunukirira** - Bino si birowoozo by'omusingi eby'okutandikira

**D. Amagezi n'obuwanvu bw'omuyengo** - "Amagezi" si kirowoozo kituufu mu ssaayansi y'amayengo

Ekibuuzo ekituufu:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kikwata ku **embeera ya Doppler** - ekyo kwe kukyukakyuka kw'eddoboozi oba frequency olw'omuvuduko wakati w'ensibuko y'eddoboozi n'omuwuliriza.

Nnekaliriza buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Kyogera ku ngeri ennyingo z'amayengo gye zinyigirizibwa oba okwawukanyizibwa - kino kikwata ku compression ne rarefaction, naye si nnyonnyola ntuufu ya Doppler effect.

**B.** Kyogera ku kunoonya speed n'omuwendo gw'eddoboozi - kino si nnyonnyola ya Doppler effect.

**C.** Kyogera ku misinde egy'enjawulo wakati w'akakungaanya n'omuwerekereza - kino si ntuufu nnyo.

**D.** Kino kinnyonnyola bulungi nti omulambuzi alaba **enjawulo mu bungi bw'amayengo (frequency)** olw'**omuvuduko** gw'agenda nagwo okusemberera oba okwewala ekintu ekiweereza amayengo. Kino kye kigendererwa kya Doppler effect - frequency change olw'relative motion.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kino: "Okutegeera ebikolwa eby'okukyusa ebintu nga bikozesa okwongera oba okukendeeza obungi bwa oxygen mu bulamu obwa bulijjo n'engeri gye bikosaamu abantu b'omulembe guno"

Ebikulu mu kigendererwa:
1. Ebikolwa eby'okukyusa ebintu (chemical changes)
2. Okwongera oba okukendeeza obungi bwa oxygen (oxidation/reduction)
3. Mu bulamu obwa bulijjo (everyday life)
4. Engeri gye bikosaamu abantu (impact on people)

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Enkuba ey'asidi - Kino kikwata ku kukyusa ebintu n'oxygen, era kya mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, era kirina enkosa ku bantu.

B. Obuzito bw'ebintu - Kino kikwata ku bipimo, naye si nnyo ku kukyusa ebintu nga bikozesa oxygen.

C. Okwoksisayizibwa kw'emiyuwa gy'ekikomo - Kino kikwata nnyo ku oxidation (okwongera oxygen), mu bulamu obwa bulijjo (amazzi ag'okunywa), era kirina enkosa ku bantu.

D. Obusannyalaza - Kino kikwata ku nkola ya kemiko naye si nnyo ku oxygen specifically.

Ekisobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino obulungi kye **C** kubanga kikwata ku:
- Okwoksisayizibwa (oxidation - okwongera oxygen)
- Mu bulamu obwa bulijjo (amazzi ag'okunywa)
- Enkosa ku bantu (amazzi amalungi)

**C**

Nneekebeza ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye "Kutegeka n'okunnyonnyola ebikwaata ku physicochemical properties z'ebintu ebirina obutonde bw'obutonde."

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga:
1. **Okutegeka** - okusengeka data
2. **Okunnyonnyola** - okutegeera lwaki ebintu birina empisa ezo

Nneekebeza buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Bawe data, basabe okukekkereza - Kino kikola prediction yokka, si kutegeka na kunnyonnyola empisa

**B.** Banoonyereze, bategeke mu mmeeza, balambulule - Kino kirina okutegeka (mu mmeeza) naye okunnyonnyola si kungi nnyo

**C.** Bawe data etegekeddwa, bannyonnyole empisa okusinziira ku mikwanaganyo egireeteddwa molekyuulu - Kino kirina okutegeka (data etegekeddwa) era **okunnyonnyola** (lwaki empisa eyo - olw'enkolagana za molekyuulu)

**D.** Bawe data, bategeke, bannyonnyole okusinziira ku bunene bw'enkolagana - Kino nakyo kirina okutegeka n'okunnyonnyola naye kifaanana nnyo ne C

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omulimu oguleka omuntu **okukebereza** ekigendererwa. Mu C ne D, bombi balina okutegeka n'okunnyonnyola. Naye **D** egulawo abayizi okutegeka data bennyini (si data etegekeddwa dda) era bannyonnyole okusinziira ku bunene bw'enkolagana - kino kisobozesa okukebereza obulungi ekigendererwa.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa agenda kukebera:
1. Okutegeera enkola z'ekemiko mu bintu ebibeerawo okubetooloola
2. Obukulu bw'eby'okusoma obukwata ku kumanya okukwata ku ssaayansi

Ekizibu: Ekibinja kireeta ebikolwa bino:
- Sodium hydroxide ne hydrochloric acid (ekikolwa)
- Okukolebwa kwa hydrochloric acid okuva mu hydrogen ne chlorine (okukolebwa)
- Okukolebwa kwa carbon dioxide okuva mu carbon ne oxygen (okukolebwa)

Ekizibu kiri nti abayizi baleese "okukolebwa" (synthesis) mu kifo ky'ebikolwa bya bulijjo ebibeerawo okubetooloola.

Ekibuuzo ekisinga okuluŋŋamya abayizi okuddayo ku kigendererwa (okukiikirira enkola z'ekemiko mu bintu ebya bulijjo) kye:

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku bintu abayizi bye balina okuba bamaze okukakasa okusobola okutegeera emisingi gy'ekibalangulo kya Bernoulli.

Ekibalangulo kya Bernoulli kikwata ku:
- Okugezesa okw'amasoboza mu bintu ebikulukusi
- Ebiva ebibiri byokka (okuwangula/okufiirwa)
- Okugezesa okw'okwesigama

Emisingi egikulu egy'okusooka:
- Abayizi balina okutegeera **amasoboza** n'engeri gye gakola
- Balina okumanya omusingi **ogw'okukuuma amasoboza** (probability conservation) - nti amasoboza gonna agattiddwa gaba 1 oba 100%

Nga tutunuulira ebyokuddamu:

A. Omusingi gwa Pascal - guno gujja oluvannyuma
B. Omusingi ogw'okukuuma amasoboza - guno gwe musingi omukulu ogw'okusooka
C. Obutasalako mu bikulukusi - kino kijja oluvannyuma
D. Emikwanaganyo gya kinemaatika - kino nakyo kijja oluvannyuma

**B**
